Pas yeh hadeeth sirf un hi ki riwayat se hai toh alawah ghareeb hone ke munkir hai aur agar sabit ho bhi jaye toh mumkin hai yeh waqiya kisi khwab ka ho. Is mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Main baitha tha ke aik darakht hai jis mein parindon ke aashiyanon ki tarah baithne ki jaghein bani hui hain, aik mein toh Hazrat Jibrail baith gaye aur dusre mein main baith gaya. Phir woh darakht buland hone laga yahan tak ke main aasman ke bilkul qareeb pohch gaya, main dayen bayen karwatein badalta tha aur agar main chahta toh hath barha kar aasman ko chhu leta. 

Maine dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail us waqt haibat-e-Elahi se misl boriye ke peechhe ja rahe thay, us waqt main samajh gaya ke Allah ki jalalat-o-qadr ke ilm mein unhe mujh par fazilat hai. Aasman ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza mujh par khul gaya, maine bahut bara azeem-ush-shan noor dekha aur parde ke paas dur-o-yaqoot ko hilte aur harkat karte dekha. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne jo wahi farmani chahi woh farmayi. 

Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko apni asli surat mein dekha hai, un ke chhe sau par thay, har aik aisa jis ne aasman ke kinare pur kar diye thay, un se zumrud, moti aur marwareed jhar rahe thay. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jibrail ﷺ se khwahish ki ke main aap ko aap ki asli surat mein dekhna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibrail ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye, aap ne dua ki toh mashriq ki taraf se aap ko koi cheez oonchi uthti hui aur phailti hui nazar aayi jise dekh kar aap behosh hogaye. Jibrail foran aaye aur aap ko hosh mein laye aur aap ke rukhsaaron se luab-e-mubarak door kiya.

Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Lahab aur uska beta Utbah Sham ke safar ki taiyariyan karne lage, uske bete ne kaha safar mein jaane se pehle ek martaba zara Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ko unke samne galiyan to de aaon, chunancha yeh aaya aur kaha "Aap Muhammad jo qareeb hua aur utra, aur do kamanon ke barabar balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeek aagaya" mein to iska munkir hoon (chunki yeh nahinjar sakt beh-adab tha aur baar baar gustakhi se pesh aata tha). Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaan se uske liye bad-dua nikal gayi ke Bari Ta'ala apne kutton mein se ek kutta is par muqarrar kar de. Yeh jab laut kar apne baap ke paas aaya aur saari baatein keh sunaein to usne kaha "Beta! Ab mujhe to teri jaan ka andesha ho gaya, iski dua radd na jayegi." 

Iske baad yeh qafila yahan se rawanah huwa aur Sham ki sarzameen mein ek rahib ke ibadat khane ke paas padao kiya. Rahib ne unse kaha "Yahan to bhediye is tarah phirte hain jaise bakriyon ke rewar, tum yahan kyun aagaye?" Abu Lahab yeh sun kar thithak gaya aur tamam qafile walon ko jama kar ke kaha "Dekho mere budhape ka haal tumhein maloom hai aur tum jante ho ke mere kaise kuch huqooq tum par hain, aaj main tumse ek arz karta hoon, umeed karta hoon ke tum sab isse qabool karoge, baat yeh hai ke mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ne mere jigar-goshe ke liye bad-dua ki hai aur mujhe iski jaan ka khatra hai, tum apna sab asbab is ibadat khane ke paas jama karo aur us par mere pyare bachhe ko sulao aur tum sab iske gird-o-pesh pehra do." 

Logon ne ise manzoor kar liya, yeh apne sab jatan kar ke hoshiyar rahe ke achanak sher aaya aur sab ke munh soonghne laga. Jab sab ke munh soongh chuka aur goya jise talash kar raha tha use na paya to pichle pairon hat kar bahut zor se just ki aur ek chhalang mein us machan par pahunch gaya, wahan ja kar uska bhi munh soongha aur goya wahi uska matloob tha, phir to usne uske parchhe uda diye, cheer phaad kar tukde tukde kar dala. Us waqt Abu Lahab kehne laga "Iska to mujhe pehle hi yaqeen tha ke Muhammad ﷺ ki bad-dua ke baad yeh bach nahi sakta."

Phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Jibrail Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se qareeb hue aur zameen ki taraf utre yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aur Hazrat Jibrail ke darmiyan sirf do kamanon ke barabar fasla reh gaya balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeeki ho gayi. Yahan lafz (Aw) jiski khabar di jati hai iske sabit karne ke liye aaya hai aur is par jo ziyadati ho iske nafi ke liye, jaise aur jagah hai phir iske baad tumhare dil sakt ho gaye pas woh misl patron ke hain Ayat (Aw ashaddu qaswatan) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 74) balkay usse bhi zyada sakt yani patthar se kam kisi surat mein nahi balkay usse bhi sakhti mein badhe hue hain. 

Ek aur farman hai "Woh logon se aisa darte hain jaisa ke Allah se" Ayat (Aw ashadda khashyatan) (Surah (An-Nisa: 77) balkay usse bhi zyada. Aur jagah hai "Humne unhein ek lakh ki taraf bheja balkay zyada ki taraf" yani woh ek lakh se kam to the hi nahi balkay haqiqatan woh ek lakh the ya usse zyada hi zyada.

Pas apni khabar ki tehqeeq hai shak-o-taraddud ke liye nahi, khabar mein Allah ki taraf se shak ke sath bayaan nahi hosakta. Yeh qareeb aane wale Hazrat Jibrail the jaise Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha, Ibn Masood, Abu Zar, Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ka farmaan hai aur is baabat ki hadeethein bhi anqareeb hum waarid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se apne Rabb ko do dafa dekha jin mein se ek ka bayaan is aayat (Thumma dana fatadalla) (Surah (An-Najm: 8) mein hai. Hazrat Anas wali Meraj ki hadees mein hai phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat qareeb hua aur neeche aaya aur isi liye muhaddiseen ne is mein kalaam kiya hai aur kayi ek gharabatein sabit ki hain aur agar sabit hojaye ke yeh sahih hai to bhi doosre waqt aur doosre waqie par mahmool hogi, is aayat ki tafseer nahi kahi jasakti. Yeh waqia to us waqt ka hai jabke Rasool Allah ﷺ zameen par the na ke Meraj wali raat ka. Kyunke is ke bayaan ke baad hi farmaya hai hamare Nabi ne use ek martaba aur bhi Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekha hai, pas yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekhna to waqia-e-Meraj ka zikr hai aur pehli martaba ka dekhna yeh zameen par tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maine Jibrail ko dekha un ke chhe so par the. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Nabi ﷺ ki ibtida-e-nubuwwat ke waqt aap ne khwab mein Hazrat Jibrail ko dekha phir aap apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye nikle to suna ke koi aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukaar raha hai, harchand dayen bayen dekha lekin koi nazar na aaya, teen martaba aisa hi hua. Teesri baar aap ne oopar ki taraf dekha to dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail apne dono paano mein se ek ko doosre samet mode hue aasmaan ke kinaron ko roke hain, qareeb tha ke Huzoor dehshat-zada hojayein ke farishte ne kaha main Jibrail hoon, main Jibrail hoon, daro nahi lekin Huzoor ﷺ se zabt na hosaka, bhaag kar logon mein chale aaye ab jo nazrein dalein to kuch dikhayi na diya, phir yahan se nikal kar baahar gaye aur aasmaan ki taraf nazar dali to phir Hazrat Jibrail usi tarah nazar aaye, aap phir khauf-zada logon ke majma' mein aagaye to yahan kuch bhi nahi, baahar nikal kar phir jo dekha to wahi samaan nazar aaya, pas isi ka zikr in aayaton mein hai (Fa kana qaba qawsayni aw adna) (Surah (An-Najm: 9). Aadhe angli ko bhi kehte hain aur baaz kehte hain sirf do haath ka fasla reh gaya tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Hazrat Jibrail par do reshmi hulle the, phir farmaya us ne wahi ki, is se muraad ya to yeh hai ke Hazrat Jibrail ne Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ki taraf wahi ki ya yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande ki taraf Jibrail ki ma'rifat apni wahi nazil farmayi. Dono ma'ani sahih hain. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is waqt ki wahi aayat (Alam yajidka yateeman fa awa) (Surah (Ad-Duha: 6) aur aayat (Wa rafa'na laka zikrak) (Surah (Ash-Sharh: 4) thi.

Al-Sharah: (4) thi aur hazrat se marwi hai ke us waqt yeh wahi nazil hui thi ke nabiyon par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke aap us mein na jayen aur ummaton par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke pehle us ki ummat dakhil na hojaye. Ibn Abbas farmate hain aap ne apne dil se Allah ko do dafa dekha hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood ne dekhne ko mutlaq rakha hai yani khwah dil ka dekhna ho khwah zahiri aankhon ka, yeh mumkin hai ke is mutlaq ko bhi muqayyad par mahmool karein yani aap ne apne dil se dekha. Jin ba'z hazrat ne kaha hai ke apni un aankhon se dekha, unhon ne ek ghareeb qaul kaha hai is liye ke sahaba se is bare mein koi cheez sehat ke sath marwi nahi. Imam Baghwi farmate hain ek jama'at is taraf gayi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni aankhon se dekha jaise Hazrat Anas, Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Ikrimah, un ke is qaul mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha. Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain maine yeh sun kar kaha phir yeh ayat kahan jayegi jis mein farman hai: Ayat (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabeer) (Al-An'am: 103) - Use koi nigaah nahi pa sakti aur woh sab nigaahon ko pa leta hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke yeh us waqt hai jabke woh apne noor ki poori tajalli kare warna aap ne do dafa apne Rab ko dekha. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. 

Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn Abbas ki mulaqat Hazrat Ka'ab se hui aur unhe pehchan kar un se ek sawal kiya jo un par bahut giran guzra. Ibn Abbas ne farmaya humein Bani Hashim ne yeh khabar di hai to Hazrat Ka'ab ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne apna deedar aur apna kalam Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ aur Hazrat Musa ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya, Hazrat Musa se do martaba baatein keen aur An-Hazrat ko do martaba apna deedar karaya. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Masroq Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ke paas gaye aur pucha ke kya Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? Aap ne farmaya tu ne to aisi baat keh di ke jis se mere rongte khade ho gaye. Maine kaha mayi sahibah Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai aap ne apne Rab ki nishaniyan dekheen. Aap ne farmaya kahan ja rahe ho? Suno is se murad Hazrat Jibreel ka dekhna hai. Jo tum se kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha ya Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ke kisi farman ko chhupa liya ya aap un paanch baaton mein se koi baat jaante the yani Qayamat kab qaim hogi? Barish kab aur kitni barsegi? Maan ke pait mein nar hai ya madah? Kaun kal kya karega? Kaun kahan marega?

Usne bari jhoot baat kahi aur Allah par buhtaan bandha. Baat yeh hai ke Aap ne do martaba Allah ke us Jibrail-e-Amin ko dekha tha, Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha hai, ek to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas aur ek martaba Jiyad mein, un ke chhe sau par the aur asman ke kul kinaare unho ne bhar rakhe the. Nasai mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se riwayat hai ke kya tumhe taajjub maloom hota hai ke khillat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa A.S ke liye aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke liye? Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se riwayat hai ke main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se pucha kya aap ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? To Aap ne farmaya woh sarasar noor hai, main ise kaise dekh sakta hoon? Ek riwayat mein hai main ne noor dekha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke sahaba ke is sawal ke jawab mein Aap ne farmaya main ne apne dil se apne Rab ko do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) parhi. Aur riwayat mein hai main ne apni in aankhon se nahi dekha haan dil se do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Summa dana fatadalla 53. (An-Najm: 8) parhi. Hazrat Ikramah R.A se ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) ki baabat sawal hua to Aap ne farmaya haan Aap ne dekha aur phir dekha. Sayil ne phir Hazrat Hasan R.A se bhi sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya is ke jalal o azmat aur chadar-e-kibriyai ko dekha. Huzoor ﷺ se ek martaba yeh jawab dena bhi marwi hai ke main ne nehar dekhi aur nehar ke peeche parda dekha aur parde ke peeche noor dekha is ke siva main ne kuch nahi dekha, yeh hadith bhi bohat ghareeb hai. Ek hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main ne apne Rab Azzawajal ko dekha hai, is ki isnad shart-e-sahih par hai lekin yeh hadith hadith-e-khwab ka mukhtasar tukra hai, chunacha mutawwal hadith mein hai ke mere paas mera Rab bohat achhi surat mein aaj ki raat aya (rawi kehta hai mere khayal mein) khwab mein aya aur farmaya-e-Muhammad ﷺ jaante ho buland maqam wale farishte kis masla par guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha nahi, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apna hath mere do bazuo ke darmiyan rakha jis ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui, pas zameen o asman ki har cheez mujhe maloom ho gayi, phir mujh se wahi sawal kiya, main ne kaha ab mujhe maloom ho gaya woh un nekiyon ke bare mein jo gunahon ka kaffara ban jati hain aur jo darje barhati hain aapas mein pooch gachh kar rahe hain. Mujh se Haq Jalla Shanuhu ne pucha achha phir tum bhi batao kaffare ki nekiyan kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namazon ke baad mein masjidon mein ruke rehna, jamaat ke liye chal kar aana, jab wuzu nagawar guzarta ho achhi tarah mal mal kar wuzu karna, jo aisa karega woh bhalayi ke sath zindagi guzarega aur khair ke sath inteqal hoga aur gunahon se is tarah alag ho jayega jaise aaj duniya mein aya tha.

Is waqt Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya, "Aiye Muhammad ﷺ jab namaz padho yeh kaho: (Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khairati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa idha aradta bi 'ibadika fitnatan an taqbidhani ilaika ghaira maftunin)." Yaani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se nekiyon ke karne, buraiyon ke chhodne, maskino se mohabbat rakhne ki taufiq talab karta hoon, to jab apne bando ko fitne mein dalna chahe to mujhe fitne mein padne se pehle hi apni taraf utha lena." Farmaya aur darje badhane wale aamal yeh hain: khana khilana, salam phailana, logo ke neend ke waqt raat ko tahajjud ki namaz padhna. Isi ki misl riwayat Surah Sad Makki ki tafsir ke khatme par guzar chuki hai. Ibn Jarir mein yeh riwayat doosri sanad se marwi hai, jis mein gurbat wali ziyadati aur bhi bahut si hai. Is mein kaffare ke bayan mein hai ke jumma ki namaz ke liye paidal chalne ke qadam, ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar. Main ne kaha, "Ya Allah! Tu ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya aur Hazrat Musa ko apna Kalim banaya aur yeh kya?" Pas Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, "Main ne tera seena khol nahi diya aur tera bojh hata nahi diya? Aur fulaan aur fulaan ehsan tere upar nahi kiye?" Aur digar aise aise ehsan bataye ke tumhare samne un ke bayan ki mujhe ijazat nahi. Isi ka bayan in aayato mein, aayat: (Thumma dana fatadalla) (An-Najm: 8), mein hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne meri aankho ka noor mere dil mein paida kar diya aur main ne Allah Ta'ala ko apne dil se dekha. Is ki isnad zaeif hai. Upar Utbah bin Abu Lahab ka yeh kehna ke "Main is qareeb aane aur nazdeek hone wale ko nahi manta" aur phir Huzoor ﷺ ka us ke liye bad-dua karna aur sher ka use phaad khana bayan ho chuka hai. Yeh waqia Zarqa mein ya Sarat mein hua tha aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne paish-goi farma di thi ke yeh is tarah halak hoga. 

Phir An-Hazrat ﷺ ka Hazrat Jibrail ko dobara dekhna bayan ho raha hai jo Meraj wali raat ka waqia hai. Meraj ki hadeethein nihayat tafseel ke sath Surah Subhan ki shuru aayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain jin ke dobara yahan warid karne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh bhi bayan guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas Meraj wali raat deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hone ke qayil hain. Ek jamat salaf-o-khalaf ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur sahaba ki bahut si jamatein is ke khilaf hain, isi tarah tabieen aur doosre bhi is ke khilaf hain. Huzoor ﷺ ka Jibrail ko paro samet dekhna waghera is qism ki riwayatein upar guzar chuki hain. Hazrat Aisha se Hazrat Masruq ka poochhna aur aap ka jawab bhi abhi bayan hua hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Siddiqa (R.A) apne is jawab ke baad aayat: (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabir) (6:103).

(Al-An'am: 103) ki tilawat ki aur aayat (Ma kana libasharin an yu'tiyahullahul-kitaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqula lin-nasi kunu 'ibadal-li min dunillahi wa lakin kunu rabbaniyyina bima kuntum tu'allimunal-kitaba wa bima kuntum tadrusun) (Al-Imran: 79) ki bhi tilawat farmai ya'ani koi aankh use nahi dekh sakti aur woh sab nigahon ko paliya hai kisi insan se Allah ka kalam karna mumkin nahi haan wahi se ya parde ke peeche se ho to aur baat hai phir farmaya jo tumse kahe ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ko kal ki baat ka ilm tha usne ghalat aur jhoot kaha phir aayat (Innallaha 'indahu 'ilmus-sa'ah) (Luqman: 34) aakhir tak padhi. Aur farmaya jo kahe ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ki kisi baat ko chhupaliya usne bhi jhoot kaha aur tuhmat bandhi aur phir aayat (Ya ayyuhar-rasulu balligh ma unzila ilaika min rabbika) padhi ya'ani Ae Rasool ﷺ jo tumhari jaanib tumhare Rab ki taraf nazil kiya gaya hai use pahuncha do. Haan Aap ne Hazrat Jibril ko unki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Masruq ne Hazrat Aisha ke samne Surah An-Najm ki aayat (Wahuwa bil-ufuqil-a'la) (An-Najm: 7) aur (Walaqad ra'ahu nazlatan ukhra) (An-Najm: 13) padhin iske jawab mein Umm-ul-Muminin Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya is ummat mein sabse pehle in ayaton ke mutalliq khud Nabi ﷺ se maine sawal kiya tha Aap ne farmaya isse murad mera Hazrat Jibril ko dekhna hai Aap ne sirf do dafa is Aminullah ko unki asli surat mein dekha hai ek martaba aasman se zameen par aate hue us waqt tamam khala unke jism se pur tha yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne Hazrat Abu Zar se kaha ke agar main Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhta to Aap se ek baat zaroor poochta Hazrat Abu Zar ne kaha kya poochte? Kaha yeh ke Aap ne apne Rab-e-Azzawajal ko dekha hai? Hazrat Abu Zar ne farmaya yeh sawal to khud maine Janab-e-Risalat Maab se kiya tha Aap ne jawab diya ke main ne use noor dekha woh to noor hai main use kaise dekh sakta, Sahih Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith do sanadon se marwi hai dono ke alfazon mein kuch her-pher hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad farmate hain main nahi samajh sakta ke is hadith ki kya taujih karun dil is par mutmain nahi Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Zar se manqul hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se didar kiya hai aankhon se nahi Imam Ibn Khuzaimah farmate hain Abdullah bin Shaqiq aur Hazrat Abu Zar ke darmiyan inqita' hai aur Imam Ibn Jauzi farmate hain mumkin hai Hazrat Abu Zar ka yeh sawal Meraj ke waqia se pehle ka ho aur Huzoor ﷺ ne us waqt yeh jawab diya ho agar yeh sawal Meraj ke baad Aap se kiya jata to zaroor Aap iske jawab mein haan farmate inkar na karte.

Lekin yeh qaul sartapa zaeif hai is liye ke Hazrat Aisha ka sawal qat'an Meraj ke baad tha lekin Aap ka jawab us waqt bhi inkar mein hi raha. Ba'az hazrat ne farmaya ke un se khitab un ke aql ke mutabiq kiya gaya ya yeh ke un ka yeh khayal ghalat hai chunacha Ibn Khuzaimah ne Kitab ut-Tauhid mein yahi likha hai drasal yeh mahz khata hai aur bilkul ghalati hai Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas aur Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ko dil se to dekha hai lekin apni aankhon se nahi dekha haan Hazrat Jibril ko apni aankhon se un ki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par us waqt farishte ba-kasrat thay aur Noor-e-Rabbani us par jagmaga raha tha aur qism qism ke rang jinhein siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi nahi jaan sakta, Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain Meraj wali raat An-Hazrat ﷺ Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnchay jo saatwein aasman par hai zameen se jo cheezein charhti hain woh yahin tak charhti hain phir yahan se utha li jati hain isi tarah jo cheezein Allah ki taraf se nazil hoti hain yahin tak pohnchti hain phir yahan se pohnchayi jati hain us waqt us darakht par sone ki tiddiyan ladi hui thin, Huzoor ﷺ ko wahan teen cheezein ata farmayi gayin panchoun waqt ki namazein Surah Al-Baqarah ki khatimah ki aayatein aur Aap ki ummat mein se jo mushrik na ho us ke gunahon ki bakhshish (Muslim). Abu Huraira se ya kisi aur Sahabi se riwayat hai ke jis tarah koye kisi darakht ko gher lete hain usi tarah us waqt Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par farishte cha rahay thay wahan jab Huzoor ﷺ pohnchay to Aap se kaha gaya ke jo mangna ho mango. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is darakht ki shakhien marwarid, yaqut aur zabarjad ki thin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne isay dekha aur apne dil ki aankhon se Allah ki bhi ziyarat ki. Ibn Zaid farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke Aap ne Sidra par kya dekha? Aap ne farmaya isay sone ki tiddiyan dhanke hue thin aur har ek pattay par ek ek farishta khada hua Allah ki tasbeeh kar raha tha. Aap ki nigahein dayein bayein nahi huin jis cheez ke dekhne ka hukum tha wahin lagi rahein. Sabit-qadami aur kamil ita'at ki yeh poori daleel hai ke jo hukum tha wahi baja laye jo diye gaye wahi lekar khush hue isi ko ek nazm ne tareefan kaha hai. Aap ne Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Linnuriyaka min ayatina-l-kubra 20:23) is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaniyan dikhayein jo hamari kamil qudrat aur zabardast azmat par daleel ban jayein. In dono aayaton ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Sunnat ka mazhab hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne us raat Allah ka deedar apni aankhon se nahi kiya kyunke irshad-e-bari hai ke Aap ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhein, agar khud Allah ka deedar hua hota to usi deedar ka zikr hota aur logon par se isay zahir kiya jata. Ibn Masood ka qaul guzar chuka hai ke ek martaba Aap ki khwahish par doosri dafa aasman par charhtay waqt Jibril ko Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha.

Pas jabkeh Jibraeel ne apne Rabb-e-Azzawajal ko khabar di apni asli surat mein aud kar gaye aur sajda ada kiya, pas Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dobaara dekhne se unhi ka dekhna murad hai yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur ghareeb hai.)))))))))

Ta'aruf-e-Jibra'il-e-Amin (A.S): Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke mu'allim Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) hain. Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (Innahu la-qaulu rasulin karim) (Al-Haqqah: 40). Yeh Quran ek buzurg zor-awar farishtay ka qaul hai jo Malik-e-Arsh ke haan ba-izzat sab ka mana hua hai, wahan mu'tabar hai. Yahan bhi farmaya woh quwwat wala hai, ayat (Zu mirrah) ki ek tafsir toh yahi hai, dusri yeh hai ke woh khush-shakal hai. Hadith mein bhi (mirrah) ka lafz aaya hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain sadaqah maldar par aur quwwat wale tandurust par haram hai. Phir woh seedhay kharay ho gaye yani Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S). Aur woh buland aasman ke kinaron par thay jahan se subh charhti hai jo suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibra'il ko un ki asli surat mein sirf do dafa dekha hai. Ek martaba aap ki khwahish par Amin-e-Allah apni surat mein aap ko dikhayi diye, aasmanon ke tamam kinare un ke jism se dhak gaye thay. Dobara us waqt jabke aap ko lekar Hazrat Jibra'il upar charhay thay. Yeh matlab ayat (Wa huwa bil-ufuqil a'la) (An-Najm: 7) ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is tafsir mein ek aisa qaul kaha hai jo kisi ne nahin kaha aur khud unhon ne bhi is qaul ki izafat dusre ki taraf nahin ki. Un ke farman ka mahasil yeh hai ke Jibra'il aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) dono aasmanon ke kinaron par seedhay kharay hue thay aur yeh waqia Mi'raj ki raat ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ki is tafsir ki ta'eed kisi ne nahin ki, go Imam sahab ne arabiyat ki haisiyat se isay sabit kiya hai aur arabi qawaid se yeh bhi ho sakta hai lekin hai yeh waqia ke khilaf, is liye ke yeh dekhna Mi'raj se pehle ka hai. Us waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ) zameen par thay, aap ki taraf Jibra'il utray thay aur qareeb ho gaye thay aur apni asli surat mein thay, chhay sau par thay. Phir is ke baad dobara Sidratul-Muntaha ke paas Mi'raj wali raat dekha tha. Yeh toh dusri martaba ka dekhna tha lekin pehli martaba ka dekhna toh shuru-e-risalat ke zamane ke waqt ka hai. Pehli wahi ayat (Iqra' bismi rabbikal-lazi khalaq) (Al-Alaq: 1) ki chand ayatein aap par nazil ho chuki thin, phir wahi band ho gayi thi jis ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bada khayal balkay bada malal tha, yahan tak ke kayi dafa aap ka irada hua ke pahar se gir paroon lekin bar-waqt aasman ki taraf se Hazrat Jibra'il ki yeh nida sunayi deti ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) aap Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur main Jibra'il hoon. Aap ka gham ghalat ho jata, dil pur-sukoon aur tabiyat mein qarar ho jata, wapas chalay aatay. Lekin phir kuch dinon ke baad shauq damangeer hota aur wahi-e-Ilahi ki lazzat yaad aati toh nikal kharay hotay aur pahar par se apne aap gira dena chahtay aur isi tarah Hazrat Jibra'il taskeen-o-tasalli kar diya kartay.

Yahan tak ke aik martaba Abtah mein Hazrat Jibrail apni asli surat mein zahir hogaye, chhe sau par thay, jusamat ke aasman ke tamam kinare dhak liye thay. Ab aap se qareeb aagaye aur Allah Azzawajal ki wahi aap ko pohchayi. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ko is farishte ki azmat-o-jalalat maloom hui aur jaan gaye ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh kis qadar buland martaba hai. 

Musnad Bazzar ki aik riwayat Imam Ibn Jarir ke qaul ki taayeed mein paish hosakti hai magar is ke rawi sirf Harith bin Ubaid hain jo Basra ke rehne wale shakhs hain. Abu Qudamah Eyadi un ki kunyat hai, Muslim mein un se riwayatein aayi hain lekin Imam Ibn Main unhe zaif kehte hain aur farmate hain yeh koi cheez nahi, Imam Ahmad farmate hain yeh muztarib-ul-hadith hain, Imam Abu Hatim Razi ka qaul hai ke un ki hadeethein likh li jati hain lekin un se daleel nahi li jasakti, Ibn Hibban farmate hain yeh bare wahmi thay, un se ehtijaj durust nahi. 

Pas yeh hadeeth sirf un hi ki riwayat se hai toh alawah ghareeb hone ke munkir hai aur agar sabit ho bhi jaye toh mumkin hai yeh waqiya kisi khwab ka ho. Is mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Main baitha tha ke aik darakht hai jis mein parindon ke aashiyanon ki tarah baithne ki jaghein bani hui hain, aik mein toh Hazrat Jibrail baith gaye aur dusre mein main baith gaya. Phir woh darakht buland hone laga yahan tak ke main aasman ke bilkul qareeb pohch gaya, main dayen bayen karwatein badalta tha aur agar main chahta toh hath barha kar aasman ko chhu leta. 

Maine dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail us waqt haibat-e-Elahi se misl boriye ke peechhe ja rahe thay, us waqt main samajh gaya ke Allah ki jalalat-o-qadr ke ilm mein unhe mujh par fazilat hai. Aasman ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza mujh par khul gaya, maine bahut bara azeem-ush-shan noor dekha aur parde ke paas dur-o-yaqoot ko hilte aur harkat karte dekha. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne jo wahi farmani chahi woh farmayi. 

Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko apni asli surat mein dekha hai, un ke chhe sau par thay, har aik aisa jis ne aasman ke kinare pur kar diye thay, un se zumrud, moti aur marwareed jhar rahe thay. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jibrail ﷺ se khwahish ki ke main aap ko aap ki asli surat mein dekhna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibrail ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye, aap ne dua ki toh mashriq ki taraf se aap ko koi cheez oonchi uthti hui aur phailti hui nazar aayi jise dekh kar aap behosh hogaye. Jibrail foran aaye aur aap ko hosh mein laye aur aap ke rukhsaaron se luab-e-mubarak door kiya.

Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Lahab aur uska beta Utbah Sham ke safar ki taiyariyan karne lage, uske bete ne kaha safar mein jaane se pehle ek martaba zara Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ko unke samne galiyan to de aaon, chunancha yeh aaya aur kaha "Aap Muhammad jo qareeb hua aur utra, aur do kamanon ke barabar balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeek aagaya" mein to iska munkir hoon (chunki yeh nahinjar sakt beh-adab tha aur baar baar gustakhi se pesh aata tha). Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaan se uske liye bad-dua nikal gayi ke Bari Ta'ala apne kutton mein se ek kutta is par muqarrar kar de. Yeh jab laut kar apne baap ke paas aaya aur saari baatein keh sunaein to usne kaha "Beta! Ab mujhe to teri jaan ka andesha ho gaya, iski dua radd na jayegi." 

Iske baad yeh qafila yahan se rawanah huwa aur Sham ki sarzameen mein ek rahib ke ibadat khane ke paas padao kiya. Rahib ne unse kaha "Yahan to bhediye is tarah phirte hain jaise bakriyon ke rewar, tum yahan kyun aagaye?" Abu Lahab yeh sun kar thithak gaya aur tamam qafile walon ko jama kar ke kaha "Dekho mere budhape ka haal tumhein maloom hai aur tum jante ho ke mere kaise kuch huqooq tum par hain, aaj main tumse ek arz karta hoon, umeed karta hoon ke tum sab isse qabool karoge, baat yeh hai ke mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ne mere jigar-goshe ke liye bad-dua ki hai aur mujhe iski jaan ka khatra hai, tum apna sab asbab is ibadat khane ke paas jama karo aur us par mere pyare bachhe ko sulao aur tum sab iske gird-o-pesh pehra do." 

Logon ne ise manzoor kar liya, yeh apne sab jatan kar ke hoshiyar rahe ke achanak sher aaya aur sab ke munh soonghne laga. Jab sab ke munh soongh chuka aur goya jise talash kar raha tha use na paya to pichle pairon hat kar bahut zor se just ki aur ek chhalang mein us machan par pahunch gaya, wahan ja kar uska bhi munh soongha aur goya wahi uska matloob tha, phir to usne uske parchhe uda diye, cheer phaad kar tukde tukde kar dala. Us waqt Abu Lahab kehne laga "Iska to mujhe pehle hi yaqeen tha ke Muhammad ﷺ ki bad-dua ke baad yeh bach nahi sakta."

Phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Jibrail Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se qareeb hue aur zameen ki taraf utre yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aur Hazrat Jibrail ke darmiyan sirf do kamanon ke barabar fasla reh gaya balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeeki ho gayi. Yahan lafz (Aw) jiski khabar di jati hai iske sabit karne ke liye aaya hai aur is par jo ziyadati ho iske nafi ke liye, jaise aur jagah hai phir iske baad tumhare dil sakt ho gaye pas woh misl patron ke hain Ayat (Aw ashaddu qaswatan) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 74) balkay usse bhi zyada sakt yani patthar se kam kisi surat mein nahi balkay usse bhi sakhti mein badhe hue hain. 

Ek aur farman hai "Woh logon se aisa darte hain jaisa ke Allah se" Ayat (Aw ashadda khashyatan) (Surah (An-Nisa: 77) balkay usse bhi zyada. Aur jagah hai "Humne unhein ek lakh ki taraf bheja balkay zyada ki taraf" yani woh ek lakh se kam to the hi nahi balkay haqiqatan woh ek lakh the ya usse zyada hi zyada.

Pas apni khabar ki tehqeeq hai shak-o-taraddud ke liye nahi, khabar mein Allah ki taraf se shak ke sath bayaan nahi hosakta. Yeh qareeb aane wale Hazrat Jibrail the jaise Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha, Ibn Masood, Abu Zar, Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ka farmaan hai aur is baabat ki hadeethein bhi anqareeb hum waarid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se apne Rabb ko do dafa dekha jin mein se ek ka bayaan is aayat (Thumma dana fatadalla) (Surah (An-Najm: 8) mein hai. Hazrat Anas wali Meraj ki hadees mein hai phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat qareeb hua aur neeche aaya aur isi liye muhaddiseen ne is mein kalaam kiya hai aur kayi ek gharabatein sabit ki hain aur agar sabit hojaye ke yeh sahih hai to bhi doosre waqt aur doosre waqie par mahmool hogi, is aayat ki tafseer nahi kahi jasakti. Yeh waqia to us waqt ka hai jabke Rasool Allah ﷺ zameen par the na ke Meraj wali raat ka. Kyunke is ke bayaan ke baad hi farmaya hai hamare Nabi ne use ek martaba aur bhi Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekha hai, pas yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekhna to waqia-e-Meraj ka zikr hai aur pehli martaba ka dekhna yeh zameen par tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maine Jibrail ko dekha un ke chhe so par the. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Nabi ﷺ ki ibtida-e-nubuwwat ke waqt aap ne khwab mein Hazrat Jibrail ko dekha phir aap apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye nikle to suna ke koi aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukaar raha hai, harchand dayen bayen dekha lekin koi nazar na aaya, teen martaba aisa hi hua. Teesri baar aap ne oopar ki taraf dekha to dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail apne dono paano mein se ek ko doosre samet mode hue aasmaan ke kinaron ko roke hain, qareeb tha ke Huzoor dehshat-zada hojayein ke farishte ne kaha main Jibrail hoon, main Jibrail hoon, daro nahi lekin Huzoor ﷺ se zabt na hosaka, bhaag kar logon mein chale aaye ab jo nazrein dalein to kuch dikhayi na diya, phir yahan se nikal kar baahar gaye aur aasmaan ki taraf nazar dali to phir Hazrat Jibrail usi tarah nazar aaye, aap phir khauf-zada logon ke majma' mein aagaye to yahan kuch bhi nahi, baahar nikal kar phir jo dekha to wahi samaan nazar aaya, pas isi ka zikr in aayaton mein hai (Fa kana qaba qawsayni aw adna) (Surah (An-Najm: 9). Aadhe angli ko bhi kehte hain aur baaz kehte hain sirf do haath ka fasla reh gaya tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Hazrat Jibrail par do reshmi hulle the, phir farmaya us ne wahi ki, is se muraad ya to yeh hai ke Hazrat Jibrail ne Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ki taraf wahi ki ya yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande ki taraf Jibrail ki ma'rifat apni wahi nazil farmayi. Dono ma'ani sahih hain. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is waqt ki wahi aayat (Alam yajidka yateeman fa awa) (Surah (Ad-Duha: 6) aur aayat (Wa rafa'na laka zikrak) (Surah (Ash-Sharh: 4) thi.

Al-Sharah: (4) thi aur hazrat se marwi hai ke us waqt yeh wahi nazil hui thi ke nabiyon par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke aap us mein na jayen aur ummaton par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke pehle us ki ummat dakhil na hojaye. Ibn Abbas farmate hain aap ne apne dil se Allah ko do dafa dekha hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood ne dekhne ko mutlaq rakha hai yani khwah dil ka dekhna ho khwah zahiri aankhon ka, yeh mumkin hai ke is mutlaq ko bhi muqayyad par mahmool karein yani aap ne apne dil se dekha. Jin ba'z hazrat ne kaha hai ke apni un aankhon se dekha, unhon ne ek ghareeb qaul kaha hai is liye ke sahaba se is bare mein koi cheez sehat ke sath marwi nahi. Imam Baghwi farmate hain ek jama'at is taraf gayi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni aankhon se dekha jaise Hazrat Anas, Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Ikrimah, un ke is qaul mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha. Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain maine yeh sun kar kaha phir yeh ayat kahan jayegi jis mein farman hai: Ayat (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabeer) (Al-An'am: 103) - Use koi nigaah nahi pa sakti aur woh sab nigaahon ko pa leta hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke yeh us waqt hai jabke woh apne noor ki poori tajalli kare warna aap ne do dafa apne Rab ko dekha. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. 

Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn Abbas ki mulaqat Hazrat Ka'ab se hui aur unhe pehchan kar un se ek sawal kiya jo un par bahut giran guzra. Ibn Abbas ne farmaya humein Bani Hashim ne yeh khabar di hai to Hazrat Ka'ab ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne apna deedar aur apna kalam Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ aur Hazrat Musa ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya, Hazrat Musa se do martaba baatein keen aur An-Hazrat ko do martaba apna deedar karaya. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Masroq Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ke paas gaye aur pucha ke kya Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? Aap ne farmaya tu ne to aisi baat keh di ke jis se mere rongte khade ho gaye. Maine kaha mayi sahibah Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai aap ne apne Rab ki nishaniyan dekheen. Aap ne farmaya kahan ja rahe ho? Suno is se murad Hazrat Jibreel ka dekhna hai. Jo tum se kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha ya Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ke kisi farman ko chhupa liya ya aap un paanch baaton mein se koi baat jaante the yani Qayamat kab qaim hogi? Barish kab aur kitni barsegi? Maan ke pait mein nar hai ya madah? Kaun kal kya karega? Kaun kahan marega?

Usne bari jhoot baat kahi aur Allah par buhtaan bandha. Baat yeh hai ke Aap ne do martaba Allah ke us Jibrail-e-Amin ko dekha tha, Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha hai, ek to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas aur ek martaba Jiyad mein, un ke chhe sau par the aur asman ke kul kinaare unho ne bhar rakhe the. Nasai mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se riwayat hai ke kya tumhe taajjub maloom hota hai ke khillat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa A.S ke liye aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke liye? Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se riwayat hai ke main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se pucha kya aap ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? To Aap ne farmaya woh sarasar noor hai, main ise kaise dekh sakta hoon? Ek riwayat mein hai main ne noor dekha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke sahaba ke is sawal ke jawab mein Aap ne farmaya main ne apne dil se apne Rab ko do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) parhi. Aur riwayat mein hai main ne apni in aankhon se nahi dekha haan dil se do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Summa dana fatadalla 53. (An-Najm: 8) parhi. Hazrat Ikramah R.A se ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) ki baabat sawal hua to Aap ne farmaya haan Aap ne dekha aur phir dekha. Sayil ne phir Hazrat Hasan R.A se bhi sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya is ke jalal o azmat aur chadar-e-kibriyai ko dekha. Huzoor ﷺ se ek martaba yeh jawab dena bhi marwi hai ke main ne nehar dekhi aur nehar ke peeche parda dekha aur parde ke peeche noor dekha is ke siva main ne kuch nahi dekha, yeh hadith bhi bohat ghareeb hai. Ek hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main ne apne Rab Azzawajal ko dekha hai, is ki isnad shart-e-sahih par hai lekin yeh hadith hadith-e-khwab ka mukhtasar tukra hai, chunacha mutawwal hadith mein hai ke mere paas mera Rab bohat achhi surat mein aaj ki raat aya (rawi kehta hai mere khayal mein) khwab mein aya aur farmaya-e-Muhammad ﷺ jaante ho buland maqam wale farishte kis masla par guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha nahi, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apna hath mere do bazuo ke darmiyan rakha jis ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui, pas zameen o asman ki har cheez mujhe maloom ho gayi, phir mujh se wahi sawal kiya, main ne kaha ab mujhe maloom ho gaya woh un nekiyon ke bare mein jo gunahon ka kaffara ban jati hain aur jo darje barhati hain aapas mein pooch gachh kar rahe hain. Mujh se Haq Jalla Shanuhu ne pucha achha phir tum bhi batao kaffare ki nekiyan kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namazon ke baad mein masjidon mein ruke rehna, jamaat ke liye chal kar aana, jab wuzu nagawar guzarta ho achhi tarah mal mal kar wuzu karna, jo aisa karega woh bhalayi ke sath zindagi guzarega aur khair ke sath inteqal hoga aur gunahon se is tarah alag ho jayega jaise aaj duniya mein aya tha.

Is waqt Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya, "Aiye Muhammad ﷺ jab namaz padho yeh kaho: (Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khairati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa idha aradta bi 'ibadika fitnatan an taqbidhani ilaika ghaira maftunin)." Yaani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se nekiyon ke karne, buraiyon ke chhodne, maskino se mohabbat rakhne ki taufiq talab karta hoon, to jab apne bando ko fitne mein dalna chahe to mujhe fitne mein padne se pehle hi apni taraf utha lena." Farmaya aur darje badhane wale aamal yeh hain: khana khilana, salam phailana, logo ke neend ke waqt raat ko tahajjud ki namaz padhna. Isi ki misl riwayat Surah Sad Makki ki tafsir ke khatme par guzar chuki hai. Ibn Jarir mein yeh riwayat doosri sanad se marwi hai, jis mein gurbat wali ziyadati aur bhi bahut si hai. Is mein kaffare ke bayan mein hai ke jumma ki namaz ke liye paidal chalne ke qadam, ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar. Main ne kaha, "Ya Allah! Tu ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya aur Hazrat Musa ko apna Kalim banaya aur yeh kya?" Pas Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, "Main ne tera seena khol nahi diya aur tera bojh hata nahi diya? Aur fulaan aur fulaan ehsan tere upar nahi kiye?" Aur digar aise aise ehsan bataye ke tumhare samne un ke bayan ki mujhe ijazat nahi. Isi ka bayan in aayato mein, aayat: (Thumma dana fatadalla) (An-Najm: 8), mein hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne meri aankho ka noor mere dil mein paida kar diya aur main ne Allah Ta'ala ko apne dil se dekha. Is ki isnad zaeif hai. Upar Utbah bin Abu Lahab ka yeh kehna ke "Main is qareeb aane aur nazdeek hone wale ko nahi manta" aur phir Huzoor ﷺ ka us ke liye bad-dua karna aur sher ka use phaad khana bayan ho chuka hai. Yeh waqia Zarqa mein ya Sarat mein hua tha aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne paish-goi farma di thi ke yeh is tarah halak hoga. 

Phir An-Hazrat ﷺ ka Hazrat Jibrail ko dobara dekhna bayan ho raha hai jo Meraj wali raat ka waqia hai. Meraj ki hadeethein nihayat tafseel ke sath Surah Subhan ki shuru aayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain jin ke dobara yahan warid karne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh bhi bayan guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas Meraj wali raat deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hone ke qayil hain. Ek jamat salaf-o-khalaf ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur sahaba ki bahut si jamatein is ke khilaf hain, isi tarah tabieen aur doosre bhi is ke khilaf hain. Huzoor ﷺ ka Jibrail ko paro samet dekhna waghera is qism ki riwayatein upar guzar chuki hain. Hazrat Aisha se Hazrat Masruq ka poochhna aur aap ka jawab bhi abhi bayan hua hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Siddiqa (R.A) apne is jawab ke baad aayat: (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabir) (6:103).

(Al-An'am: 103) ki tilawat ki aur aayat (Ma kana libasharin an yu'tiyahullahul-kitaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqula lin-nasi kunu 'ibadal-li min dunillahi wa lakin kunu rabbaniyyina bima kuntum tu'allimunal-kitaba wa bima kuntum tadrusun) (Al-Imran: 79) ki bhi tilawat farmai ya'ani koi aankh use nahi dekh sakti aur woh sab nigahon ko paliya hai kisi insan se Allah ka kalam karna mumkin nahi haan wahi se ya parde ke peeche se ho to aur baat hai phir farmaya jo tumse kahe ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ko kal ki baat ka ilm tha usne ghalat aur jhoot kaha phir aayat (Innallaha 'indahu 'ilmus-sa'ah) (Luqman: 34) aakhir tak padhi. Aur farmaya jo kahe ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ki kisi baat ko chhupaliya usne bhi jhoot kaha aur tuhmat bandhi aur phir aayat (Ya ayyuhar-rasulu balligh ma unzila ilaika min rabbika) padhi ya'ani Ae Rasool ﷺ jo tumhari jaanib tumhare Rab ki taraf nazil kiya gaya hai use pahuncha do. Haan Aap ne Hazrat Jibril ko unki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Masruq ne Hazrat Aisha ke samne Surah An-Najm ki aayat (Wahuwa bil-ufuqil-a'la) (An-Najm: 7) aur (Walaqad ra'ahu nazlatan ukhra) (An-Najm: 13) padhin iske jawab mein Umm-ul-Muminin Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya is ummat mein sabse pehle in ayaton ke mutalliq khud Nabi ﷺ se maine sawal kiya tha Aap ne farmaya isse murad mera Hazrat Jibril ko dekhna hai Aap ne sirf do dafa is Aminullah ko unki asli surat mein dekha hai ek martaba aasman se zameen par aate hue us waqt tamam khala unke jism se pur tha yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne Hazrat Abu Zar se kaha ke agar main Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhta to Aap se ek baat zaroor poochta Hazrat Abu Zar ne kaha kya poochte? Kaha yeh ke Aap ne apne Rab-e-Azzawajal ko dekha hai? Hazrat Abu Zar ne farmaya yeh sawal to khud maine Janab-e-Risalat Maab se kiya tha Aap ne jawab diya ke main ne use noor dekha woh to noor hai main use kaise dekh sakta, Sahih Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith do sanadon se marwi hai dono ke alfazon mein kuch her-pher hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad farmate hain main nahi samajh sakta ke is hadith ki kya taujih karun dil is par mutmain nahi Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Zar se manqul hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se didar kiya hai aankhon se nahi Imam Ibn Khuzaimah farmate hain Abdullah bin Shaqiq aur Hazrat Abu Zar ke darmiyan inqita' hai aur Imam Ibn Jauzi farmate hain mumkin hai Hazrat Abu Zar ka yeh sawal Meraj ke waqia se pehle ka ho aur Huzoor ﷺ ne us waqt yeh jawab diya ho agar yeh sawal Meraj ke baad Aap se kiya jata to zaroor Aap iske jawab mein haan farmate inkar na karte.

Lekin yeh qaul sartapa zaeif hai is liye ke Hazrat Aisha ka sawal qat'an Meraj ke baad tha lekin Aap ka jawab us waqt bhi inkar mein hi raha. Ba'az hazrat ne farmaya ke un se khitab un ke aql ke mutabiq kiya gaya ya yeh ke un ka yeh khayal ghalat hai chunacha Ibn Khuzaimah ne Kitab ut-Tauhid mein yahi likha hai drasal yeh mahz khata hai aur bilkul ghalati hai Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas aur Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ko dil se to dekha hai lekin apni aankhon se nahi dekha haan Hazrat Jibril ko apni aankhon se un ki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par us waqt farishte ba-kasrat thay aur Noor-e-Rabbani us par jagmaga raha tha aur qism qism ke rang jinhein siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi nahi jaan sakta, Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain Meraj wali raat An-Hazrat ﷺ Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnchay jo saatwein aasman par hai zameen se jo cheezein charhti hain woh yahin tak charhti hain phir yahan se utha li jati hain isi tarah jo cheezein Allah ki taraf se nazil hoti hain yahin tak pohnchti hain phir yahan se pohnchayi jati hain us waqt us darakht par sone ki tiddiyan ladi hui thin, Huzoor ﷺ ko wahan teen cheezein ata farmayi gayin panchoun waqt ki namazein Surah Al-Baqarah ki khatimah ki aayatein aur Aap ki ummat mein se jo mushrik na ho us ke gunahon ki bakhshish (Muslim). Abu Huraira se ya kisi aur Sahabi se riwayat hai ke jis tarah koye kisi darakht ko gher lete hain usi tarah us waqt Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par farishte cha rahay thay wahan jab Huzoor ﷺ pohnchay to Aap se kaha gaya ke jo mangna ho mango. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is darakht ki shakhien marwarid, yaqut aur zabarjad ki thin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne isay dekha aur apne dil ki aankhon se Allah ki bhi ziyarat ki. Ibn Zaid farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke Aap ne Sidra par kya dekha? Aap ne farmaya isay sone ki tiddiyan dhanke hue thin aur har ek pattay par ek ek farishta khada hua Allah ki tasbeeh kar raha tha. Aap ki nigahein dayein bayein nahi huin jis cheez ke dekhne ka hukum tha wahin lagi rahein. Sabit-qadami aur kamil ita'at ki yeh poori daleel hai ke jo hukum tha wahi baja laye jo diye gaye wahi lekar khush hue isi ko ek nazm ne tareefan kaha hai. Aap ne Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Linnuriyaka min ayatina-l-kubra 20:23) is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaniyan dikhayein jo hamari kamil qudrat aur zabardast azmat par daleel ban jayein. In dono aayaton ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Sunnat ka mazhab hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne us raat Allah ka deedar apni aankhon se nahi kiya kyunke irshad-e-bari hai ke Aap ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhein, agar khud Allah ka deedar hua hota to usi deedar ka zikr hota aur logon par se isay zahir kiya jata. Ibn Masood ka qaul guzar chuka hai ke ek martaba Aap ki khwahish par doosri dafa aasman par charhtay waqt Jibril ko Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha.

Pas jabkeh Jibraeel ne apne Rabb-e-Azzawajal ko khabar di apni asli surat mein aud kar gaye aur sajda ada kiya, pas Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dobaara dekhne se unhi ka dekhna murad hai yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur ghareeb hai.)))))))))

Ta'aruf-e-Jibra'il-e-Amin (A.S): Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke mu'allim Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) hain. Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (Innahu la-qaulu rasulin karim) (Al-Haqqah: 40). Yeh Quran ek buzurg zor-awar farishtay ka qaul hai jo Malik-e-Arsh ke haan ba-izzat sab ka mana hua hai, wahan mu'tabar hai. Yahan bhi farmaya woh quwwat wala hai, ayat (Zu mirrah) ki ek tafsir toh yahi hai, dusri yeh hai ke woh khush-shakal hai. Hadith mein bhi (mirrah) ka lafz aaya hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain sadaqah maldar par aur quwwat wale tandurust par haram hai. Phir woh seedhay kharay ho gaye yani Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S). Aur woh buland aasman ke kinaron par thay jahan se subh charhti hai jo suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibra'il ko un ki asli surat mein sirf do dafa dekha hai. Ek martaba aap ki khwahish par Amin-e-Allah apni surat mein aap ko dikhayi diye, aasmanon ke tamam kinare un ke jism se dhak gaye thay. Dobara us waqt jabke aap ko lekar Hazrat Jibra'il upar charhay thay. Yeh matlab ayat (Wa huwa bil-ufuqil a'la) (An-Najm: 7) ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is tafsir mein ek aisa qaul kaha hai jo kisi ne nahin kaha aur khud unhon ne bhi is qaul ki izafat dusre ki taraf nahin ki. Un ke farman ka mahasil yeh hai ke Jibra'il aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) dono aasmanon ke kinaron par seedhay kharay hue thay aur yeh waqia Mi'raj ki raat ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ki is tafsir ki ta'eed kisi ne nahin ki, go Imam sahab ne arabiyat ki haisiyat se isay sabit kiya hai aur arabi qawaid se yeh bhi ho sakta hai lekin hai yeh waqia ke khilaf, is liye ke yeh dekhna Mi'raj se pehle ka hai. Us waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ) zameen par thay, aap ki taraf Jibra'il utray thay aur qareeb ho gaye thay aur apni asli surat mein thay, chhay sau par thay. Phir is ke baad dobara Sidratul-Muntaha ke paas Mi'raj wali raat dekha tha. Yeh toh dusri martaba ka dekhna tha lekin pehli martaba ka dekhna toh shuru-e-risalat ke zamane ke waqt ka hai. Pehli wahi ayat (Iqra' bismi rabbikal-lazi khalaq) (Al-Alaq: 1) ki chand ayatein aap par nazil ho chuki thin, phir wahi band ho gayi thi jis ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bada khayal balkay bada malal tha, yahan tak ke kayi dafa aap ka irada hua ke pahar se gir paroon lekin bar-waqt aasman ki taraf se Hazrat Jibra'il ki yeh nida sunayi deti ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) aap Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur main Jibra'il hoon. Aap ka gham ghalat ho jata, dil pur-sukoon aur tabiyat mein qarar ho jata, wapas chalay aatay. Lekin phir kuch dinon ke baad shauq damangeer hota aur wahi-e-Ilahi ki lazzat yaad aati toh nikal kharay hotay aur pahar par se apne aap gira dena chahtay aur isi tarah Hazrat Jibra'il taskeen-o-tasalli kar diya kartay.

Yahan tak ke aik martaba Abtah mein Hazrat Jibrail apni asli surat mein zahir hogaye, chhe sau par thay, jusamat ke aasman ke tamam kinare dhak liye thay. Ab aap se qareeb aagaye aur Allah Azzawajal ki wahi aap ko pohchayi. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ko is farishte ki azmat-o-jalalat maloom hui aur jaan gaye ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh kis qadar buland martaba hai. 

Musnad Bazzar ki aik riwayat Imam Ibn Jarir ke qaul ki taayeed mein paish hosakti hai magar is ke rawi sirf Harith bin Ubaid hain jo Basra ke rehne wale shakhs hain. Abu Qudamah Eyadi un ki kunyat hai, Muslim mein un se riwayatein aayi hain lekin Imam Ibn Main unhe zaif kehte hain aur farmate hain yeh koi cheez nahi, Imam Ahmad farmate hain yeh muztarib-ul-hadith hain, Imam Abu Hatim Razi ka qaul hai ke un ki hadeethein likh li jati hain lekin un se daleel nahi li jasakti, Ibn Hibban farmate hain yeh bare wahmi thay, un se ehtijaj durust nahi. 

Pas yeh hadeeth sirf un hi ki riwayat se hai toh alawah ghareeb hone ke munkir hai aur agar sabit ho bhi jaye toh mumkin hai yeh waqiya kisi khwab ka ho. Is mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Main baitha tha ke aik darakht hai jis mein parindon ke aashiyanon ki tarah baithne ki jaghein bani hui hain, aik mein toh Hazrat Jibrail baith gaye aur dusre mein main baith gaya. Phir woh darakht buland hone laga yahan tak ke main aasman ke bilkul qareeb pohch gaya, main dayen bayen karwatein badalta tha aur agar main chahta toh hath barha kar aasman ko chhu leta. 

Maine dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail us waqt haibat-e-Elahi se misl boriye ke peechhe ja rahe thay, us waqt main samajh gaya ke Allah ki jalalat-o-qadr ke ilm mein unhe mujh par fazilat hai. Aasman ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza mujh par khul gaya, maine bahut bara azeem-ush-shan noor dekha aur parde ke paas dur-o-yaqoot ko hilte aur harkat karte dekha. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne jo wahi farmani chahi woh farmayi. 

Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko apni asli surat mein dekha hai, un ke chhe sau par thay, har aik aisa jis ne aasman ke kinare pur kar diye thay, un se zumrud, moti aur marwareed jhar rahe thay. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jibrail ﷺ se khwahish ki ke main aap ko aap ki asli surat mein dekhna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibrail ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye, aap ne dua ki toh mashriq ki taraf se aap ko koi cheez oonchi uthti hui aur phailti hui nazar aayi jise dekh kar aap behosh hogaye. Jibrail foran aaye aur aap ko hosh mein laye aur aap ke rukhsaaron se luab-e-mubarak door kiya.

Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Lahab aur uska beta Utbah Sham ke safar ki taiyariyan karne lage, uske bete ne kaha safar mein jaane se pehle ek martaba zara Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ko unke samne galiyan to de aaon, chunancha yeh aaya aur kaha "Aap Muhammad jo qareeb hua aur utra, aur do kamanon ke barabar balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeek aagaya" mein to iska munkir hoon (chunki yeh nahinjar sakt beh-adab tha aur baar baar gustakhi se pesh aata tha). Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaan se uske liye bad-dua nikal gayi ke Bari Ta'ala apne kutton mein se ek kutta is par muqarrar kar de. Yeh jab laut kar apne baap ke paas aaya aur saari baatein keh sunaein to usne kaha "Beta! Ab mujhe to teri jaan ka andesha ho gaya, iski dua radd na jayegi." 

Iske baad yeh qafila yahan se rawanah huwa aur Sham ki sarzameen mein ek rahib ke ibadat khane ke paas padao kiya. Rahib ne unse kaha "Yahan to bhediye is tarah phirte hain jaise bakriyon ke rewar, tum yahan kyun aagaye?" Abu Lahab yeh sun kar thithak gaya aur tamam qafile walon ko jama kar ke kaha "Dekho mere budhape ka haal tumhein maloom hai aur tum jante ho ke mere kaise kuch huqooq tum par hain, aaj main tumse ek arz karta hoon, umeed karta hoon ke tum sab isse qabool karoge, baat yeh hai ke mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ne mere jigar-goshe ke liye bad-dua ki hai aur mujhe iski jaan ka khatra hai, tum apna sab asbab is ibadat khane ke paas jama karo aur us par mere pyare bachhe ko sulao aur tum sab iske gird-o-pesh pehra do." 

Logon ne ise manzoor kar liya, yeh apne sab jatan kar ke hoshiyar rahe ke achanak sher aaya aur sab ke munh soonghne laga. Jab sab ke munh soongh chuka aur goya jise talash kar raha tha use na paya to pichle pairon hat kar bahut zor se just ki aur ek chhalang mein us machan par pahunch gaya, wahan ja kar uska bhi munh soongha aur goya wahi uska matloob tha, phir to usne uske parchhe uda diye, cheer phaad kar tukde tukde kar dala. Us waqt Abu Lahab kehne laga "Iska to mujhe pehle hi yaqeen tha ke Muhammad ﷺ ki bad-dua ke baad yeh bach nahi sakta."

Phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Jibrail Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se qareeb hue aur zameen ki taraf utre yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aur Hazrat Jibrail ke darmiyan sirf do kamanon ke barabar fasla reh gaya balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeeki ho gayi. Yahan lafz (Aw) jiski khabar di jati hai iske sabit karne ke liye aaya hai aur is par jo ziyadati ho iske nafi ke liye, jaise aur jagah hai phir iske baad tumhare dil sakt ho gaye pas woh misl patron ke hain Ayat (Aw ashaddu qaswatan) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 74) balkay usse bhi zyada sakt yani patthar se kam kisi surat mein nahi balkay usse bhi sakhti mein badhe hue hain. 

Ek aur farman hai "Woh logon se aisa darte hain jaisa ke Allah se" Ayat (Aw ashadda khashyatan) (Surah (An-Nisa: 77) balkay usse bhi zyada. Aur jagah hai "Humne unhein ek lakh ki taraf bheja balkay zyada ki taraf" yani woh ek lakh se kam to the hi nahi balkay haqiqatan woh ek lakh the ya usse zyada hi zyada.

Pas apni khabar ki tehqeeq hai shak-o-taraddud ke liye nahi, khabar mein Allah ki taraf se shak ke sath bayaan nahi hosakta. Yeh qareeb aane wale Hazrat Jibrail the jaise Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha, Ibn Masood, Abu Zar, Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ka farmaan hai aur is baabat ki hadeethein bhi anqareeb hum waarid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se apne Rabb ko do dafa dekha jin mein se ek ka bayaan is aayat (Thumma dana fatadalla) (Surah (An-Najm: 8) mein hai. Hazrat Anas wali Meraj ki hadees mein hai phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat qareeb hua aur neeche aaya aur isi liye muhaddiseen ne is mein kalaam kiya hai aur kayi ek gharabatein sabit ki hain aur agar sabit hojaye ke yeh sahih hai to bhi doosre waqt aur doosre waqie par mahmool hogi, is aayat ki tafseer nahi kahi jasakti. Yeh waqia to us waqt ka hai jabke Rasool Allah ﷺ zameen par the na ke Meraj wali raat ka. Kyunke is ke bayaan ke baad hi farmaya hai hamare Nabi ne use ek martaba aur bhi Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekha hai, pas yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekhna to waqia-e-Meraj ka zikr hai aur pehli martaba ka dekhna yeh zameen par tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maine Jibrail ko dekha un ke chhe so par the. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Nabi ﷺ ki ibtida-e-nubuwwat ke waqt aap ne khwab mein Hazrat Jibrail ko dekha phir aap apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye nikle to suna ke koi aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukaar raha hai, harchand dayen bayen dekha lekin koi nazar na aaya, teen martaba aisa hi hua. Teesri baar aap ne oopar ki taraf dekha to dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail apne dono paano mein se ek ko doosre samet mode hue aasmaan ke kinaron ko roke hain, qareeb tha ke Huzoor dehshat-zada hojayein ke farishte ne kaha main Jibrail hoon, main Jibrail hoon, daro nahi lekin Huzoor ﷺ se zabt na hosaka, bhaag kar logon mein chale aaye ab jo nazrein dalein to kuch dikhayi na diya, phir yahan se nikal kar baahar gaye aur aasmaan ki taraf nazar dali to phir Hazrat Jibrail usi tarah nazar aaye, aap phir khauf-zada logon ke majma' mein aagaye to yahan kuch bhi nahi, baahar nikal kar phir jo dekha to wahi samaan nazar aaya, pas isi ka zikr in aayaton mein hai (Fa kana qaba qawsayni aw adna) (Surah (An-Najm: 9). Aadhe angli ko bhi kehte hain aur baaz kehte hain sirf do haath ka fasla reh gaya tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Hazrat Jibrail par do reshmi hulle the, phir farmaya us ne wahi ki, is se muraad ya to yeh hai ke Hazrat Jibrail ne Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ki taraf wahi ki ya yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande ki taraf Jibrail ki ma'rifat apni wahi nazil farmayi. Dono ma'ani sahih hain. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is waqt ki wahi aayat (Alam yajidka yateeman fa awa) (Surah (Ad-Duha: 6) aur aayat (Wa rafa'na laka zikrak) (Surah (Ash-Sharh: 4) thi.

Al-Sharah: (4) thi aur hazrat se marwi hai ke us waqt yeh wahi nazil hui thi ke nabiyon par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke aap us mein na jayen aur ummaton par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke pehle us ki ummat dakhil na hojaye. Ibn Abbas farmate hain aap ne apne dil se Allah ko do dafa dekha hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood ne dekhne ko mutlaq rakha hai yani khwah dil ka dekhna ho khwah zahiri aankhon ka, yeh mumkin hai ke is mutlaq ko bhi muqayyad par mahmool karein yani aap ne apne dil se dekha. Jin ba'z hazrat ne kaha hai ke apni un aankhon se dekha, unhon ne ek ghareeb qaul kaha hai is liye ke sahaba se is bare mein koi cheez sehat ke sath marwi nahi. Imam Baghwi farmate hain ek jama'at is taraf gayi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni aankhon se dekha jaise Hazrat Anas, Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Ikrimah, un ke is qaul mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha. Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain maine yeh sun kar kaha phir yeh ayat kahan jayegi jis mein farman hai: Ayat (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabeer) (Al-An'am: 103) - Use koi nigaah nahi pa sakti aur woh sab nigaahon ko pa leta hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke yeh us waqt hai jabke woh apne noor ki poori tajalli kare warna aap ne do dafa apne Rab ko dekha. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. 

Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn Abbas ki mulaqat Hazrat Ka'ab se hui aur unhe pehchan kar un se ek sawal kiya jo un par bahut giran guzra. Ibn Abbas ne farmaya humein Bani Hashim ne yeh khabar di hai to Hazrat Ka'ab ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne apna deedar aur apna kalam Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ aur Hazrat Musa ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya, Hazrat Musa se do martaba baatein keen aur An-Hazrat ko do martaba apna deedar karaya. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Masroq Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ke paas gaye aur pucha ke kya Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? Aap ne farmaya tu ne to aisi baat keh di ke jis se mere rongte khade ho gaye. Maine kaha mayi sahibah Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai aap ne apne Rab ki nishaniyan dekheen. Aap ne farmaya kahan ja rahe ho? Suno is se murad Hazrat Jibreel ka dekhna hai. Jo tum se kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha ya Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ke kisi farman ko chhupa liya ya aap un paanch baaton mein se koi baat jaante the yani Qayamat kab qaim hogi? Barish kab aur kitni barsegi? Maan ke pait mein nar hai ya madah? Kaun kal kya karega? Kaun kahan marega?

Usne bari jhoot baat kahi aur Allah par buhtaan bandha. Baat yeh hai ke Aap ne do martaba Allah ke us Jibrail-e-Amin ko dekha tha, Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha hai, ek to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas aur ek martaba Jiyad mein, un ke chhe sau par the aur asman ke kul kinaare unho ne bhar rakhe the. Nasai mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se riwayat hai ke kya tumhe taajjub maloom hota hai ke khillat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa A.S ke liye aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke liye? Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se riwayat hai ke main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se pucha kya aap ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? To Aap ne farmaya woh sarasar noor hai, main ise kaise dekh sakta hoon? Ek riwayat mein hai main ne noor dekha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke sahaba ke is sawal ke jawab mein Aap ne farmaya main ne apne dil se apne Rab ko do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) parhi. Aur riwayat mein hai main ne apni in aankhon se nahi dekha haan dil se do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Summa dana fatadalla 53. (An-Najm: 8) parhi. Hazrat Ikramah R.A se ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) ki baabat sawal hua to Aap ne farmaya haan Aap ne dekha aur phir dekha. Sayil ne phir Hazrat Hasan R.A se bhi sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya is ke jalal o azmat aur chadar-e-kibriyai ko dekha. Huzoor ﷺ se ek martaba yeh jawab dena bhi marwi hai ke main ne nehar dekhi aur nehar ke peeche parda dekha aur parde ke peeche noor dekha is ke siva main ne kuch nahi dekha, yeh hadith bhi bohat ghareeb hai. Ek hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main ne apne Rab Azzawajal ko dekha hai, is ki isnad shart-e-sahih par hai lekin yeh hadith hadith-e-khwab ka mukhtasar tukra hai, chunacha mutawwal hadith mein hai ke mere paas mera Rab bohat achhi surat mein aaj ki raat aya (rawi kehta hai mere khayal mein) khwab mein aya aur farmaya-e-Muhammad ﷺ jaante ho buland maqam wale farishte kis masla par guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha nahi, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apna hath mere do bazuo ke darmiyan rakha jis ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui, pas zameen o asman ki har cheez mujhe maloom ho gayi, phir mujh se wahi sawal kiya, main ne kaha ab mujhe maloom ho gaya woh un nekiyon ke bare mein jo gunahon ka kaffara ban jati hain aur jo darje barhati hain aapas mein pooch gachh kar rahe hain. Mujh se Haq Jalla Shanuhu ne pucha achha phir tum bhi batao kaffare ki nekiyan kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namazon ke baad mein masjidon mein ruke rehna, jamaat ke liye chal kar aana, jab wuzu nagawar guzarta ho achhi tarah mal mal kar wuzu karna, jo aisa karega woh bhalayi ke sath zindagi guzarega aur khair ke sath inteqal hoga aur gunahon se is tarah alag ho jayega jaise aaj duniya mein aya tha.

Is waqt Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya, "Aiye Muhammad ﷺ jab namaz padho yeh kaho: (Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khairati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa idha aradta bi 'ibadika fitnatan an taqbidhani ilaika ghaira maftunin)." Yaani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se nekiyon ke karne, buraiyon ke chhodne, maskino se mohabbat rakhne ki taufiq talab karta hoon, to jab apne bando ko fitne mein dalna chahe to mujhe fitne mein padne se pehle hi apni taraf utha lena." Farmaya aur darje badhane wale aamal yeh hain: khana khilana, salam phailana, logo ke neend ke waqt raat ko tahajjud ki namaz padhna. Isi ki misl riwayat Surah Sad Makki ki tafsir ke khatme par guzar chuki hai. Ibn Jarir mein yeh riwayat doosri sanad se marwi hai, jis mein gurbat wali ziyadati aur bhi bahut si hai. Is mein kaffare ke bayan mein hai ke jumma ki namaz ke liye paidal chalne ke qadam, ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar. Main ne kaha, "Ya Allah! Tu ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya aur Hazrat Musa ko apna Kalim banaya aur yeh kya?" Pas Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, "Main ne tera seena khol nahi diya aur tera bojh hata nahi diya? Aur fulaan aur fulaan ehsan tere upar nahi kiye?" Aur digar aise aise ehsan bataye ke tumhare samne un ke bayan ki mujhe ijazat nahi. Isi ka bayan in aayato mein, aayat: (Thumma dana fatadalla) (An-Najm: 8), mein hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne meri aankho ka noor mere dil mein paida kar diya aur main ne Allah Ta'ala ko apne dil se dekha. Is ki isnad zaeif hai. Upar Utbah bin Abu Lahab ka yeh kehna ke "Main is qareeb aane aur nazdeek hone wale ko nahi manta" aur phir Huzoor ﷺ ka us ke liye bad-dua karna aur sher ka use phaad khana bayan ho chuka hai. Yeh waqia Zarqa mein ya Sarat mein hua tha aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne paish-goi farma di thi ke yeh is tarah halak hoga. 

Phir An-Hazrat ﷺ ka Hazrat Jibrail ko dobara dekhna bayan ho raha hai jo Meraj wali raat ka waqia hai. Meraj ki hadeethein nihayat tafseel ke sath Surah Subhan ki shuru aayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain jin ke dobara yahan warid karne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh bhi bayan guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas Meraj wali raat deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hone ke qayil hain. Ek jamat salaf-o-khalaf ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur sahaba ki bahut si jamatein is ke khilaf hain, isi tarah tabieen aur doosre bhi is ke khilaf hain. Huzoor ﷺ ka Jibrail ko paro samet dekhna waghera is qism ki riwayatein upar guzar chuki hain. Hazrat Aisha se Hazrat Masruq ka poochhna aur aap ka jawab bhi abhi bayan hua hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Siddiqa (R.A) apne is jawab ke baad aayat: (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabir) (6:103).

(Al-An'am: 103) ki tilawat ki aur aayat (Ma kana libasharin an yu'tiyahullahul-kitaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqula lin-nasi kunu 'ibadal-li min dunillahi wa lakin kunu rabbaniyyina bima kuntum tu'allimunal-kitaba wa bima kuntum tadrusun) (Al-Imran: 79) ki bhi tilawat farmai ya'ani koi aankh use nahi dekh sakti aur woh sab nigahon ko paliya hai kisi insan se Allah ka kalam karna mumkin nahi haan wahi se ya parde ke peeche se ho to aur baat hai phir farmaya jo tumse kahe ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ko kal ki baat ka ilm tha usne ghalat aur jhoot kaha phir aayat (Innallaha 'indahu 'ilmus-sa'ah) (Luqman: 34) aakhir tak padhi. Aur farmaya jo kahe ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ki kisi baat ko chhupaliya usne bhi jhoot kaha aur tuhmat bandhi aur phir aayat (Ya ayyuhar-rasulu balligh ma unzila ilaika min rabbika) padhi ya'ani Ae Rasool ﷺ jo tumhari jaanib tumhare Rab ki taraf nazil kiya gaya hai use pahuncha do. Haan Aap ne Hazrat Jibril ko unki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Masruq ne Hazrat Aisha ke samne Surah An-Najm ki aayat (Wahuwa bil-ufuqil-a'la) (An-Najm: 7) aur (Walaqad ra'ahu nazlatan ukhra) (An-Najm: 13) padhin iske jawab mein Umm-ul-Muminin Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya is ummat mein sabse pehle in ayaton ke mutalliq khud Nabi ﷺ se maine sawal kiya tha Aap ne farmaya isse murad mera Hazrat Jibril ko dekhna hai Aap ne sirf do dafa is Aminullah ko unki asli surat mein dekha hai ek martaba aasman se zameen par aate hue us waqt tamam khala unke jism se pur tha yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne Hazrat Abu Zar se kaha ke agar main Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhta to Aap se ek baat zaroor poochta Hazrat Abu Zar ne kaha kya poochte? Kaha yeh ke Aap ne apne Rab-e-Azzawajal ko dekha hai? Hazrat Abu Zar ne farmaya yeh sawal to khud maine Janab-e-Risalat Maab se kiya tha Aap ne jawab diya ke main ne use noor dekha woh to noor hai main use kaise dekh sakta, Sahih Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith do sanadon se marwi hai dono ke alfazon mein kuch her-pher hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad farmate hain main nahi samajh sakta ke is hadith ki kya taujih karun dil is par mutmain nahi Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Zar se manqul hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se didar kiya hai aankhon se nahi Imam Ibn Khuzaimah farmate hain Abdullah bin Shaqiq aur Hazrat Abu Zar ke darmiyan inqita' hai aur Imam Ibn Jauzi farmate hain mumkin hai Hazrat Abu Zar ka yeh sawal Meraj ke waqia se pehle ka ho aur Huzoor ﷺ ne us waqt yeh jawab diya ho agar yeh sawal Meraj ke baad Aap se kiya jata to zaroor Aap iske jawab mein haan farmate inkar na karte.

Lekin yeh qaul sartapa zaeif hai is liye ke Hazrat Aisha ka sawal qat'an Meraj ke baad tha lekin Aap ka jawab us waqt bhi inkar mein hi raha. Ba'az hazrat ne farmaya ke un se khitab un ke aql ke mutabiq kiya gaya ya yeh ke un ka yeh khayal ghalat hai chunacha Ibn Khuzaimah ne Kitab ut-Tauhid mein yahi likha hai drasal yeh mahz khata hai aur bilkul ghalati hai Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas aur Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ko dil se to dekha hai lekin apni aankhon se nahi dekha haan Hazrat Jibril ko apni aankhon se un ki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par us waqt farishte ba-kasrat thay aur Noor-e-Rabbani us par jagmaga raha tha aur qism qism ke rang jinhein siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi nahi jaan sakta, Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain Meraj wali raat An-Hazrat ﷺ Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnchay jo saatwein aasman par hai zameen se jo cheezein charhti hain woh yahin tak charhti hain phir yahan se utha li jati hain isi tarah jo cheezein Allah ki taraf se nazil hoti hain yahin tak pohnchti hain phir yahan se pohnchayi jati hain us waqt us darakht par sone ki tiddiyan ladi hui thin, Huzoor ﷺ ko wahan teen cheezein ata farmayi gayin panchoun waqt ki namazein Surah Al-Baqarah ki khatimah ki aayatein aur Aap ki ummat mein se jo mushrik na ho us ke gunahon ki bakhshish (Muslim). Abu Huraira se ya kisi aur Sahabi se riwayat hai ke jis tarah koye kisi darakht ko gher lete hain usi tarah us waqt Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par farishte cha rahay thay wahan jab Huzoor ﷺ pohnchay to Aap se kaha gaya ke jo mangna ho mango. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is darakht ki shakhien marwarid, yaqut aur zabarjad ki thin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne isay dekha aur apne dil ki aankhon se Allah ki bhi ziyarat ki. Ibn Zaid farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke Aap ne Sidra par kya dekha? Aap ne farmaya isay sone ki tiddiyan dhanke hue thin aur har ek pattay par ek ek farishta khada hua Allah ki tasbeeh kar raha tha. Aap ki nigahein dayein bayein nahi huin jis cheez ke dekhne ka hukum tha wahin lagi rahein. Sabit-qadami aur kamil ita'at ki yeh poori daleel hai ke jo hukum tha wahi baja laye jo diye gaye wahi lekar khush hue isi ko ek nazm ne tareefan kaha hai. Aap ne Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Linnuriyaka min ayatina-l-kubra 20:23) is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaniyan dikhayein jo hamari kamil qudrat aur zabardast azmat par daleel ban jayein. In dono aayaton ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Sunnat ka mazhab hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne us raat Allah ka deedar apni aankhon se nahi kiya kyunke irshad-e-bari hai ke Aap ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhein, agar khud Allah ka deedar hua hota to usi deedar ka zikr hota aur logon par se isay zahir kiya jata. Ibn Masood ka qaul guzar chuka hai ke ek martaba Aap ki khwahish par doosri dafa aasman par charhtay waqt Jibril ko Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha.

Pas jabkeh Jibraeel ne apne Rabb-e-Azzawajal ko khabar di apni asli surat mein aud kar gaye aur sajda ada kiya, pas Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dobaara dekhne se unhi ka dekhna murad hai yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur ghareeb hai.)))))))))

Ta'aruf-e-Jibra'il-e-Amin (A.S): Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke mu'allim Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) hain. Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (Innahu la-qaulu rasulin karim) (Al-Haqqah: 40). Yeh Quran ek buzurg zor-awar farishtay ka qaul hai jo Malik-e-Arsh ke haan ba-izzat sab ka mana hua hai, wahan mu'tabar hai. Yahan bhi farmaya woh quwwat wala hai, ayat (Zu mirrah) ki ek tafsir toh yahi hai, dusri yeh hai ke woh khush-shakal hai. Hadith mein bhi (mirrah) ka lafz aaya hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain sadaqah maldar par aur quwwat wale tandurust par haram hai. Phir woh seedhay kharay ho gaye yani Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S). Aur woh buland aasman ke kinaron par thay jahan se subh charhti hai jo suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibra'il ko un ki asli surat mein sirf do dafa dekha hai. Ek martaba aap ki khwahish par Amin-e-Allah apni surat mein aap ko dikhayi diye, aasmanon ke tamam kinare un ke jism se dhak gaye thay. Dobara us waqt jabke aap ko lekar Hazrat Jibra'il upar charhay thay. Yeh matlab ayat (Wa huwa bil-ufuqil a'la) (An-Najm: 7) ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is tafsir mein ek aisa qaul kaha hai jo kisi ne nahin kaha aur khud unhon ne bhi is qaul ki izafat dusre ki taraf nahin ki. Un ke farman ka mahasil yeh hai ke Jibra'il aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) dono aasmanon ke kinaron par seedhay kharay hue thay aur yeh waqia Mi'raj ki raat ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ki is tafsir ki ta'eed kisi ne nahin ki, go Imam sahab ne arabiyat ki haisiyat se isay sabit kiya hai aur arabi qawaid se yeh bhi ho sakta hai lekin hai yeh waqia ke khilaf, is liye ke yeh dekhna Mi'raj se pehle ka hai. Us waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ) zameen par thay, aap ki taraf Jibra'il utray thay aur qareeb ho gaye thay aur apni asli surat mein thay, chhay sau par thay. Phir is ke baad dobara Sidratul-Muntaha ke paas Mi'raj wali raat dekha tha. Yeh toh dusri martaba ka dekhna tha lekin pehli martaba ka dekhna toh shuru-e-risalat ke zamane ke waqt ka hai. Pehli wahi ayat (Iqra' bismi rabbikal-lazi khalaq) (Al-Alaq: 1) ki chand ayatein aap par nazil ho chuki thin, phir wahi band ho gayi thi jis ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bada khayal balkay bada malal tha, yahan tak ke kayi dafa aap ka irada hua ke pahar se gir paroon lekin bar-waqt aasman ki taraf se Hazrat Jibra'il ki yeh nida sunayi deti ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) aap Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur main Jibra'il hoon. Aap ka gham ghalat ho jata, dil pur-sukoon aur tabiyat mein qarar ho jata, wapas chalay aatay. Lekin phir kuch dinon ke baad shauq damangeer hota aur wahi-e-Ilahi ki lazzat yaad aati toh nikal kharay hotay aur pahar par se apne aap gira dena chahtay aur isi tarah Hazrat Jibra'il taskeen-o-tasalli kar diya kartay.

Yahan tak ke aik martaba Abtah mein Hazrat Jibrail apni asli surat mein zahir hogaye, chhe sau par thay, jusamat ke aasman ke tamam kinare dhak liye thay. Ab aap se qareeb aagaye aur Allah Azzawajal ki wahi aap ko pohchayi. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ko is farishte ki azmat-o-jalalat maloom hui aur jaan gaye ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh kis qadar buland martaba hai. 

Musnad Bazzar ki aik riwayat Imam Ibn Jarir ke qaul ki taayeed mein paish hosakti hai magar is ke rawi sirf Harith bin Ubaid hain jo Basra ke rehne wale shakhs hain. Abu Qudamah Eyadi un ki kunyat hai, Muslim mein un se riwayatein aayi hain lekin Imam Ibn Main unhe zaif kehte hain aur farmate hain yeh koi cheez nahi, Imam Ahmad farmate hain yeh muztarib-ul-hadith hain, Imam Abu Hatim Razi ka qaul hai ke un ki hadeethein likh li jati hain lekin un se daleel nahi li jasakti, Ibn Hibban farmate hain yeh bare wahmi thay, un se ehtijaj durust nahi. 

Pas yeh hadeeth sirf un hi ki riwayat se hai toh alawah ghareeb hone ke munkir hai aur agar sabit ho bhi jaye toh mumkin hai yeh waqiya kisi khwab ka ho. Is mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Main baitha tha ke aik darakht hai jis mein parindon ke aashiyanon ki tarah baithne ki jaghein bani hui hain, aik mein toh Hazrat Jibrail baith gaye aur dusre mein main baith gaya. Phir woh darakht buland hone laga yahan tak ke main aasman ke bilkul qareeb pohch gaya, main dayen bayen karwatein badalta tha aur agar main chahta toh hath barha kar aasman ko chhu leta. 

Maine dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail us waqt haibat-e-Elahi se misl boriye ke peechhe ja rahe thay, us waqt main samajh gaya ke Allah ki jalalat-o-qadr ke ilm mein unhe mujh par fazilat hai. Aasman ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza mujh par khul gaya, maine bahut bara azeem-ush-shan noor dekha aur parde ke paas dur-o-yaqoot ko hilte aur harkat karte dekha. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne jo wahi farmani chahi woh farmayi. 

Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko apni asli surat mein dekha hai, un ke chhe sau par thay, har aik aisa jis ne aasman ke kinare pur kar diye thay, un se zumrud, moti aur marwareed jhar rahe thay. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jibrail ﷺ se khwahish ki ke main aap ko aap ki asli surat mein dekhna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibrail ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye, aap ne dua ki toh mashriq ki taraf se aap ko koi cheez oonchi uthti hui aur phailti hui nazar aayi jise dekh kar aap behosh hogaye. Jibrail foran aaye aur aap ko hosh mein laye aur aap ke rukhsaaron se luab-e-mubarak door kiya.

Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Lahab aur uska beta Utbah Sham ke safar ki taiyariyan karne lage, uske bete ne kaha safar mein jaane se pehle ek martaba zara Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ko unke samne galiyan to de aaon, chunancha yeh aaya aur kaha "Aap Muhammad jo qareeb hua aur utra, aur do kamanon ke barabar balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeek aagaya" mein to iska munkir hoon (chunki yeh nahinjar sakt beh-adab tha aur baar baar gustakhi se pesh aata tha). Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaan se uske liye bad-dua nikal gayi ke Bari Ta'ala apne kutton mein se ek kutta is par muqarrar kar de. Yeh jab laut kar apne baap ke paas aaya aur saari baatein keh sunaein to usne kaha "Beta! Ab mujhe to teri jaan ka andesha ho gaya, iski dua radd na jayegi." 

Iske baad yeh qafila yahan se rawanah huwa aur Sham ki sarzameen mein ek rahib ke ibadat khane ke paas padao kiya. Rahib ne unse kaha "Yahan to bhediye is tarah phirte hain jaise bakriyon ke rewar, tum yahan kyun aagaye?" Abu Lahab yeh sun kar thithak gaya aur tamam qafile walon ko jama kar ke kaha "Dekho mere budhape ka haal tumhein maloom hai aur tum jante ho ke mere kaise kuch huqooq tum par hain, aaj main tumse ek arz karta hoon, umeed karta hoon ke tum sab isse qabool karoge, baat yeh hai ke mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ne mere jigar-goshe ke liye bad-dua ki hai aur mujhe iski jaan ka khatra hai, tum apna sab asbab is ibadat khane ke paas jama karo aur us par mere pyare bachhe ko sulao aur tum sab iske gird-o-pesh pehra do." 

Logon ne ise manzoor kar liya, yeh apne sab jatan kar ke hoshiyar rahe ke achanak sher aaya aur sab ke munh soonghne laga. Jab sab ke munh soongh chuka aur goya jise talash kar raha tha use na paya to pichle pairon hat kar bahut zor se just ki aur ek chhalang mein us machan par pahunch gaya, wahan ja kar uska bhi munh soongha aur goya wahi uska matloob tha, phir to usne uske parchhe uda diye, cheer phaad kar tukde tukde kar dala. Us waqt Abu Lahab kehne laga "Iska to mujhe pehle hi yaqeen tha ke Muhammad ﷺ ki bad-dua ke baad yeh bach nahi sakta."

Phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Jibrail Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se qareeb hue aur zameen ki taraf utre yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aur Hazrat Jibrail ke darmiyan sirf do kamanon ke barabar fasla reh gaya balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeeki ho gayi. Yahan lafz (Aw) jiski khabar di jati hai iske sabit karne ke liye aaya hai aur is par jo ziyadati ho iske nafi ke liye, jaise aur jagah hai phir iske baad tumhare dil sakt ho gaye pas woh misl patron ke hain Ayat (Aw ashaddu qaswatan) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 74) balkay usse bhi zyada sakt yani patthar se kam kisi surat mein nahi balkay usse bhi sakhti mein badhe hue hain. 

Ek aur farman hai "Woh logon se aisa darte hain jaisa ke Allah se" Ayat (Aw ashadda khashyatan) (Surah (An-Nisa: 77) balkay usse bhi zyada. Aur jagah hai "Humne unhein ek lakh ki taraf bheja balkay zyada ki taraf" yani woh ek lakh se kam to the hi nahi balkay haqiqatan woh ek lakh the ya usse zyada hi zyada.

Pas apni khabar ki tehqeeq hai shak-o-taraddud ke liye nahi, khabar mein Allah ki taraf se shak ke sath bayaan nahi hosakta. Yeh qareeb aane wale Hazrat Jibrail the jaise Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha, Ibn Masood, Abu Zar, Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ka farmaan hai aur is baabat ki hadeethein bhi anqareeb hum waarid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se apne Rabb ko do dafa dekha jin mein se ek ka bayaan is aayat (Thumma dana fatadalla) (Surah (An-Najm: 8) mein hai. Hazrat Anas wali Meraj ki hadees mein hai phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat qareeb hua aur neeche aaya aur isi liye muhaddiseen ne is mein kalaam kiya hai aur kayi ek gharabatein sabit ki hain aur agar sabit hojaye ke yeh sahih hai to bhi doosre waqt aur doosre waqie par mahmool hogi, is aayat ki tafseer nahi kahi jasakti. Yeh waqia to us waqt ka hai jabke Rasool Allah ﷺ zameen par the na ke Meraj wali raat ka. Kyunke is ke bayaan ke baad hi farmaya hai hamare Nabi ne use ek martaba aur bhi Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekha hai, pas yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekhna to waqia-e-Meraj ka zikr hai aur pehli martaba ka dekhna yeh zameen par tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maine Jibrail ko dekha un ke chhe so par the. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Nabi ﷺ ki ibtida-e-nubuwwat ke waqt aap ne khwab mein Hazrat Jibrail ko dekha phir aap apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye nikle to suna ke koi aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukaar raha hai, harchand dayen bayen dekha lekin koi nazar na aaya, teen martaba aisa hi hua.
