Hazrat Anas aur Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ko dil se to dekha hai lekin apni aankhon se nahi dekha haan Hazrat Jibril ko apni aankhon se un ki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par us waqt farishte ba-kasrat thay aur Noor-e-Rabbani us par jagmaga raha tha aur qism qism ke rang jinhein siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi nahi jaan sakta, Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain Meraj wali raat An-Hazrat ﷺ Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnchay jo saatwein aasman par hai zameen se jo cheezein charhti hain woh yahin tak charhti hain phir yahan se utha li jati hain isi tarah jo cheezein Allah ki taraf se nazil hoti hain yahin tak pohnchti hain phir yahan se pohnchayi jati hain us waqt us darakht par sone ki tiddiyan ladi hui thin, Huzoor ﷺ ko wahan teen cheezein ata farmayi gayin panchoun waqt ki namazein Surah Al-Baqarah ki khatimah ki aayatein aur Aap ki ummat mein se jo mushrik na ho us ke gunahon ki bakhshish (Muslim). Abu Huraira se ya kisi aur Sahabi se riwayat hai ke jis tarah koye kisi darakht ko gher lete hain usi tarah us waqt Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par farishte cha rahay thay wahan jab Huzoor ﷺ pohnchay to Aap se kaha gaya ke jo mangna ho mango. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is darakht ki shakhien marwarid, yaqut aur zabarjad ki thin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne isay dekha aur apne dil ki aankhon se Allah ki bhi ziyarat ki. Ibn Zaid farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke Aap ne Sidra par kya dekha? Aap ne farmaya isay sone ki tiddiyan dhanke hue thin aur har ek pattay par ek ek farishta khada hua Allah ki tasbeeh kar raha tha. Aap ki nigahein dayein bayein nahi huin jis cheez ke dekhne ka hukum tha wahin lagi rahein. Sabit-qadami aur kamil ita'at ki yeh poori daleel hai ke jo hukum tha wahi baja laye jo diye gaye wahi lekar khush hue isi ko ek nazm ne tareefan kaha hai. Aap ne Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Linnuriyaka min ayatina-l-kubra 20:23) is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaniyan dikhayein jo hamari kamil qudrat aur zabardast azmat par daleel ban jayein. In dono aayaton ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Sunnat ka mazhab hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne us raat Allah ka deedar apni aankhon se nahi kiya kyunke irshad-e-bari hai ke Aap ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhein, agar khud Allah ka deedar hua hota to usi deedar ka zikr hota aur logon par se isay zahir kiya jata. Ibn Masood ka qaul guzar chuka hai ke ek martaba Aap ki khwahish par doosri dafa aasman par charhtay waqt Jibril ko Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha.

Pas jabkeh Jibraeel ne apne Rabb-e-Azzawajal ko khabar di apni asli surat mein aud kar gaye aur sajda ada kiya, pas Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dobaara dekhne se unhi ka dekhna murad hai yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur ghareeb hai.)))))))))

Ta'aruf-e-Jibra'il-e-Amin (A.S): Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke mu'allim Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S) hain. Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ayat (Innahu la-qaulu rasulin karim) (Al-Haqqah: 40). Yeh Quran ek buzurg zor-awar farishtay ka qaul hai jo Malik-e-Arsh ke haan ba-izzat sab ka mana hua hai, wahan mu'tabar hai. Yahan bhi farmaya woh quwwat wala hai, ayat (Zu mirrah) ki ek tafsir toh yahi hai, dusri yeh hai ke woh khush-shakal hai. Hadith mein bhi (mirrah) ka lafz aaya hai, Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain sadaqah maldar par aur quwwat wale tandurust par haram hai. Phir woh seedhay kharay ho gaye yani Hazrat Jibra'il (A.S). Aur woh buland aasman ke kinaron par thay jahan se subh charhti hai jo suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jibra'il ko un ki asli surat mein sirf do dafa dekha hai. Ek martaba aap ki khwahish par Amin-e-Allah apni surat mein aap ko dikhayi diye, aasmanon ke tamam kinare un ke jism se dhak gaye thay. Dobara us waqt jabke aap ko lekar Hazrat Jibra'il upar charhay thay. Yeh matlab ayat (Wa huwa bil-ufuqil a'la) (An-Najm: 7) ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne is tafsir mein ek aisa qaul kaha hai jo kisi ne nahin kaha aur khud unhon ne bhi is qaul ki izafat dusre ki taraf nahin ki. Un ke farman ka mahasil yeh hai ke Jibra'il aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) dono aasmanon ke kinaron par seedhay kharay hue thay aur yeh waqia Mi'raj ki raat ka hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ki is tafsir ki ta'eed kisi ne nahin ki, go Imam sahab ne arabiyat ki haisiyat se isay sabit kiya hai aur arabi qawaid se yeh bhi ho sakta hai lekin hai yeh waqia ke khilaf, is liye ke yeh dekhna Mi'raj se pehle ka hai. Us waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ) zameen par thay, aap ki taraf Jibra'il utray thay aur qareeb ho gaye thay aur apni asli surat mein thay, chhay sau par thay. Phir is ke baad dobara Sidratul-Muntaha ke paas Mi'raj wali raat dekha tha. Yeh toh dusri martaba ka dekhna tha lekin pehli martaba ka dekhna toh shuru-e-risalat ke zamane ke waqt ka hai. Pehli wahi ayat (Iqra' bismi rabbikal-lazi khalaq) (Al-Alaq: 1) ki chand ayatein aap par nazil ho chuki thin, phir wahi band ho gayi thi jis ka Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bada khayal balkay bada malal tha, yahan tak ke kayi dafa aap ka irada hua ke pahar se gir paroon lekin bar-waqt aasman ki taraf se Hazrat Jibra'il ki yeh nida sunayi deti ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) aap Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur main Jibra'il hoon. Aap ka gham ghalat ho jata, dil pur-sukoon aur tabiyat mein qarar ho jata, wapas chalay aatay. Lekin phir kuch dinon ke baad shauq damangeer hota aur wahi-e-Ilahi ki lazzat yaad aati toh nikal kharay hotay aur pahar par se apne aap gira dena chahtay aur isi tarah Hazrat Jibra'il taskeen-o-tasalli kar diya kartay.

Yahan tak ke aik martaba Abtah mein Hazrat Jibrail apni asli surat mein zahir hogaye, chhe sau par thay, jusamat ke aasman ke tamam kinare dhak liye thay. Ab aap se qareeb aagaye aur Allah Azzawajal ki wahi aap ko pohchayi. Us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ko is farishte ki azmat-o-jalalat maloom hui aur jaan gaye ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh kis qadar buland martaba hai. 

Musnad Bazzar ki aik riwayat Imam Ibn Jarir ke qaul ki taayeed mein paish hosakti hai magar is ke rawi sirf Harith bin Ubaid hain jo Basra ke rehne wale shakhs hain. Abu Qudamah Eyadi un ki kunyat hai, Muslim mein un se riwayatein aayi hain lekin Imam Ibn Main unhe zaif kehte hain aur farmate hain yeh koi cheez nahi, Imam Ahmad farmate hain yeh muztarib-ul-hadith hain, Imam Abu Hatim Razi ka qaul hai ke un ki hadeethein likh li jati hain lekin un se daleel nahi li jasakti, Ibn Hibban farmate hain yeh bare wahmi thay, un se ehtijaj durust nahi. 

Pas yeh hadeeth sirf un hi ki riwayat se hai toh alawah ghareeb hone ke munkir hai aur agar sabit ho bhi jaye toh mumkin hai yeh waqiya kisi khwab ka ho. Is mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Main baitha tha ke aik darakht hai jis mein parindon ke aashiyanon ki tarah baithne ki jaghein bani hui hain, aik mein toh Hazrat Jibrail baith gaye aur dusre mein main baith gaya. Phir woh darakht buland hone laga yahan tak ke main aasman ke bilkul qareeb pohch gaya, main dayen bayen karwatein badalta tha aur agar main chahta toh hath barha kar aasman ko chhu leta. 

Maine dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail us waqt haibat-e-Elahi se misl boriye ke peechhe ja rahe thay, us waqt main samajh gaya ke Allah ki jalalat-o-qadr ke ilm mein unhe mujh par fazilat hai. Aasman ke darwazon mein se aik darwaza mujh par khul gaya, maine bahut bara azeem-ush-shan noor dekha aur parde ke paas dur-o-yaqoot ko hilte aur harkat karte dekha. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne jo wahi farmani chahi woh farmayi. 

Musnad mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Jibrail ko apni asli surat mein dekha hai, un ke chhe sau par thay, har aik aisa jis ne aasman ke kinare pur kar diye thay, un se zumrud, moti aur marwareed jhar rahe thay. 

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Jibrail ﷺ se khwahish ki ke main aap ko aap ki asli surat mein dekhna chahta hoon. Hazrat Jibrail ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye, aap ne dua ki toh mashriq ki taraf se aap ko koi cheez oonchi uthti hui aur phailti hui nazar aayi jise dekh kar aap behosh hogaye. Jibrail foran aaye aur aap ko hosh mein laye aur aap ke rukhsaaron se luab-e-mubarak door kiya.

Ibn Asakir mein hai ke Abu Lahab aur uska beta Utbah Sham ke safar ki taiyariyan karne lage, uske bete ne kaha safar mein jaane se pehle ek martaba zara Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ko unke samne galiyan to de aaon, chunancha yeh aaya aur kaha "Aap Muhammad jo qareeb hua aur utra, aur do kamanon ke barabar balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeek aagaya" mein to iska munkir hoon (chunki yeh nahinjar sakt beh-adab tha aur baar baar gustakhi se pesh aata tha). Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaan se uske liye bad-dua nikal gayi ke Bari Ta'ala apne kutton mein se ek kutta is par muqarrar kar de. Yeh jab laut kar apne baap ke paas aaya aur saari baatein keh sunaein to usne kaha "Beta! Ab mujhe to teri jaan ka andesha ho gaya, iski dua radd na jayegi." 

Iske baad yeh qafila yahan se rawanah huwa aur Sham ki sarzameen mein ek rahib ke ibadat khane ke paas padao kiya. Rahib ne unse kaha "Yahan to bhediye is tarah phirte hain jaise bakriyon ke rewar, tum yahan kyun aagaye?" Abu Lahab yeh sun kar thithak gaya aur tamam qafile walon ko jama kar ke kaha "Dekho mere budhape ka haal tumhein maloom hai aur tum jante ho ke mere kaise kuch huqooq tum par hain, aaj main tumse ek arz karta hoon, umeed karta hoon ke tum sab isse qabool karoge, baat yeh hai ke mudda'i-e-nubuwwat ne mere jigar-goshe ke liye bad-dua ki hai aur mujhe iski jaan ka khatra hai, tum apna sab asbab is ibadat khane ke paas jama karo aur us par mere pyare bachhe ko sulao aur tum sab iske gird-o-pesh pehra do." 

Logon ne ise manzoor kar liya, yeh apne sab jatan kar ke hoshiyar rahe ke achanak sher aaya aur sab ke munh soonghne laga. Jab sab ke munh soongh chuka aur goya jise talash kar raha tha use na paya to pichle pairon hat kar bahut zor se just ki aur ek chhalang mein us machan par pahunch gaya, wahan ja kar uska bhi munh soongha aur goya wahi uska matloob tha, phir to usne uske parchhe uda diye, cheer phaad kar tukde tukde kar dala. Us waqt Abu Lahab kehne laga "Iska to mujhe pehle hi yaqeen tha ke Muhammad ﷺ ki bad-dua ke baad yeh bach nahi sakta."

Phir farmata hai ke Hazrat Jibrail Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se qareeb hue aur zameen ki taraf utre yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ke aur Hazrat Jibrail ke darmiyan sirf do kamanon ke barabar fasla reh gaya balkay usse bhi zyada nazdeeki ho gayi. Yahan lafz (Aw) jiski khabar di jati hai iske sabit karne ke liye aaya hai aur is par jo ziyadati ho iske nafi ke liye, jaise aur jagah hai phir iske baad tumhare dil sakt ho gaye pas woh misl patron ke hain Ayat (Aw ashaddu qaswatan) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 74) balkay usse bhi zyada sakt yani patthar se kam kisi surat mein nahi balkay usse bhi sakhti mein badhe hue hain. 

Ek aur farman hai "Woh logon se aisa darte hain jaisa ke Allah se" Ayat (Aw ashadda khashyatan) (Surah (An-Nisa: 77) balkay usse bhi zyada. Aur jagah hai "Humne unhein ek lakh ki taraf bheja balkay zyada ki taraf" yani woh ek lakh se kam to the hi nahi balkay haqiqatan woh ek lakh the ya usse zyada hi zyada.

Pas apni khabar ki tehqeeq hai shak-o-taraddud ke liye nahi, khabar mein Allah ki taraf se shak ke sath bayaan nahi hosakta. Yeh qareeb aane wale Hazrat Jibrail the jaise Umm-ul-Momineen Ayesha, Ibn Masood, Abu Zar, Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ka farmaan hai aur is baabat ki hadeethein bhi anqareeb hum waarid karenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se apne Rabb ko do dafa dekha jin mein se ek ka bayaan is aayat (Thumma dana fatadalla) (Surah (An-Najm: 8) mein hai. Hazrat Anas wali Meraj ki hadees mein hai phir Allah Ta'ala Rabb-ul-Izzat qareeb hua aur neeche aaya aur isi liye muhaddiseen ne is mein kalaam kiya hai aur kayi ek gharabatein sabit ki hain aur agar sabit hojaye ke yeh sahih hai to bhi doosre waqt aur doosre waqie par mahmool hogi, is aayat ki tafseer nahi kahi jasakti. Yeh waqia to us waqt ka hai jabke Rasool Allah ﷺ zameen par the na ke Meraj wali raat ka. Kyunke is ke bayaan ke baad hi farmaya hai hamare Nabi ne use ek martaba aur bhi Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekha hai, pas yeh Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dekhna to waqia-e-Meraj ka zikr hai aur pehli martaba ka dekhna yeh zameen par tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood farmate hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya maine Jibrail ko dekha un ke chhe so par the. Hazrat Ayesha farmati hain Nabi ﷺ ki ibtida-e-nubuwwat ke waqt aap ne khwab mein Hazrat Jibrail ko dekha phir aap apni zaroori haajat se farigh hone ke liye nikle to suna ke koi aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukaar raha hai, harchand dayen bayen dekha lekin koi nazar na aaya, teen martaba aisa hi hua. Teesri baar aap ne oopar ki taraf dekha to dekha ke Hazrat Jibrail apne dono paano mein se ek ko doosre samet mode hue aasmaan ke kinaron ko roke hain, qareeb tha ke Huzoor dehshat-zada hojayein ke farishte ne kaha main Jibrail hoon, main Jibrail hoon, daro nahi lekin Huzoor ﷺ se zabt na hosaka, bhaag kar logon mein chale aaye ab jo nazrein dalein to kuch dikhayi na diya, phir yahan se nikal kar baahar gaye aur aasmaan ki taraf nazar dali to phir Hazrat Jibrail usi tarah nazar aaye, aap phir khauf-zada logon ke majma' mein aagaye to yahan kuch bhi nahi, baahar nikal kar phir jo dekha to wahi samaan nazar aaya, pas isi ka zikr in aayaton mein hai (Fa kana qaba qawsayni aw adna) (Surah (An-Najm: 9). Aadhe angli ko bhi kehte hain aur baaz kehte hain sirf do haath ka fasla reh gaya tha. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Hazrat Jibrail par do reshmi hulle the, phir farmaya us ne wahi ki, is se muraad ya to yeh hai ke Hazrat Jibrail ne Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool ﷺ ki taraf wahi ki ya yeh ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande ki taraf Jibrail ki ma'rifat apni wahi nazil farmayi. Dono ma'ani sahih hain. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is waqt ki wahi aayat (Alam yajidka yateeman fa awa) (Surah (Ad-Duha: 6) aur aayat (Wa rafa'na laka zikrak) (Surah (Ash-Sharh: 4) thi.

Al-Sharah: (4) thi aur hazrat se marwi hai ke us waqt yeh wahi nazil hui thi ke nabiyon par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke aap us mein na jayen aur ummaton par Jannat haram hai jab tak ke pehle us ki ummat dakhil na hojaye. Ibn Abbas farmate hain aap ne apne dil se Allah ko do dafa dekha hai. Hazrat Ibn Masood ne dekhne ko mutlaq rakha hai yani khwah dil ka dekhna ho khwah zahiri aankhon ka, yeh mumkin hai ke is mutlaq ko bhi muqayyad par mahmool karein yani aap ne apne dil se dekha. Jin ba'z hazrat ne kaha hai ke apni un aankhon se dekha, unhon ne ek ghareeb qaul kaha hai is liye ke sahaba se is bare mein koi cheez sehat ke sath marwi nahi. Imam Baghwi farmate hain ek jama'at is taraf gayi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni aankhon se dekha jaise Hazrat Anas, Hazrat Hasan aur Hazrat Ikrimah, un ke is qaul mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. 

Tirmidhi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha. Hazrat Ikrimah farmate hain maine yeh sun kar kaha phir yeh ayat kahan jayegi jis mein farman hai: Ayat (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabeer) (Al-An'am: 103) - Use koi nigaah nahi pa sakti aur woh sab nigaahon ko pa leta hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke yeh us waqt hai jabke woh apne noor ki poori tajalli kare warna aap ne do dafa apne Rab ko dekha. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. 

Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn Abbas ki mulaqat Hazrat Ka'ab se hui aur unhe pehchan kar un se ek sawal kiya jo un par bahut giran guzra. Ibn Abbas ne farmaya humein Bani Hashim ne yeh khabar di hai to Hazrat Ka'ab ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne apna deedar aur apna kalam Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ aur Hazrat Musa ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya, Hazrat Musa se do martaba baatein keen aur An-Hazrat ko do martaba apna deedar karaya. 

Ek martaba Hazrat Masroq Hazrat Aishah (R.A) ke paas gaye aur pucha ke kya Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? Aap ne farmaya tu ne to aisi baat keh di ke jis se mere rongte khade ho gaye. Maine kaha mayi sahibah Quran-e-Kareem farmata hai aap ne apne Rab ki nishaniyan dekheen. Aap ne farmaya kahan ja rahe ho? Suno is se murad Hazrat Jibreel ka dekhna hai. Jo tum se kahe ke Muhammad ne apne Rab ko dekha ya Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ke kisi farman ko chhupa liya ya aap un paanch baaton mein se koi baat jaante the yani Qayamat kab qaim hogi? Barish kab aur kitni barsegi? Maan ke pait mein nar hai ya madah? Kaun kal kya karega? Kaun kahan marega?

Usne bari jhoot baat kahi aur Allah par buhtaan bandha. Baat yeh hai ke Aap ne do martaba Allah ke us Jibrail-e-Amin ko dekha tha, Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha hai, ek to Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas aur ek martaba Jiyad mein, un ke chhe sau par the aur asman ke kul kinaare unho ne bhar rakhe the. Nasai mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se riwayat hai ke kya tumhe taajjub maloom hota hai ke khillat Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke liye thi aur kalam Hazrat Musa A.S ke liye aur deedar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke liye? Sahih Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se riwayat hai ke main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se pucha kya aap ne apne Rab ko dekha hai? To Aap ne farmaya woh sarasar noor hai, main ise kaise dekh sakta hoon? Ek riwayat mein hai main ne noor dekha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke sahaba ke is sawal ke jawab mein Aap ne farmaya main ne apne dil se apne Rab ko do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) parhi. Aur riwayat mein hai main ne apni in aankhon se nahi dekha haan dil se do dafa dekha hai, phir Aap ne ayat (Summa dana fatadalla 53. (An-Najm: 8) parhi. Hazrat Ikramah R.A se ayat (Ma kazabal-fu'adu ma ra'a 53. (An-Najm: 11) ki baabat sawal hua to Aap ne farmaya haan Aap ne dekha aur phir dekha. Sayil ne phir Hazrat Hasan R.A se bhi sawal kiya to Aap ne farmaya is ke jalal o azmat aur chadar-e-kibriyai ko dekha. Huzoor ﷺ se ek martaba yeh jawab dena bhi marwi hai ke main ne nehar dekhi aur nehar ke peeche parda dekha aur parde ke peeche noor dekha is ke siva main ne kuch nahi dekha, yeh hadith bhi bohat ghareeb hai. Ek hadith Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main ne apne Rab Azzawajal ko dekha hai, is ki isnad shart-e-sahih par hai lekin yeh hadith hadith-e-khwab ka mukhtasar tukra hai, chunacha mutawwal hadith mein hai ke mere paas mera Rab bohat achhi surat mein aaj ki raat aya (rawi kehta hai mere khayal mein) khwab mein aya aur farmaya-e-Muhammad ﷺ jaante ho buland maqam wale farishte kis masla par guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne kaha nahi, pas Allah Ta'ala ne apna hath mere do bazuo ke darmiyan rakha jis ki thandak mujhe mere seene mein mehsoos hui, pas zameen o asman ki har cheez mujhe maloom ho gayi, phir mujh se wahi sawal kiya, main ne kaha ab mujhe maloom ho gaya woh un nekiyon ke bare mein jo gunahon ka kaffara ban jati hain aur jo darje barhati hain aapas mein pooch gachh kar rahe hain. Mujh se Haq Jalla Shanuhu ne pucha achha phir tum bhi batao kaffare ki nekiyan kya kya hain? Main ne kaha namazon ke baad mein masjidon mein ruke rehna, jamaat ke liye chal kar aana, jab wuzu nagawar guzarta ho achhi tarah mal mal kar wuzu karna, jo aisa karega woh bhalayi ke sath zindagi guzarega aur khair ke sath inteqal hoga aur gunahon se is tarah alag ho jayega jaise aaj duniya mein aya tha.

Is waqt Allah Ta'ala ne mujh se farmaya, "Aiye Muhammad ﷺ jab namaz padho yeh kaho: (Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khairati wa tarkal-munkarati wa hubbal-masakini wa idha aradta bi 'ibadika fitnatan an taqbidhani ilaika ghaira maftunin)." Yaani, "Ya Allah! Main tujh se nekiyon ke karne, buraiyon ke chhodne, maskino se mohabbat rakhne ki taufiq talab karta hoon, to jab apne bando ko fitne mein dalna chahe to mujhe fitne mein padne se pehle hi apni taraf utha lena." Farmaya aur darje badhane wale aamal yeh hain: khana khilana, salam phailana, logo ke neend ke waqt raat ko tahajjud ki namaz padhna. Isi ki misl riwayat Surah Sad Makki ki tafsir ke khatme par guzar chuki hai. Ibn Jarir mein yeh riwayat doosri sanad se marwi hai, jis mein gurbat wali ziyadati aur bhi bahut si hai. Is mein kaffare ke bayan mein hai ke jumma ki namaz ke liye paidal chalne ke qadam, ek namaz ke baad doosri namaz ka intezar. Main ne kaha, "Ya Allah! Tu ne Hazrat Ibrahim ko apna Khalil banaya aur Hazrat Musa ko apna Kalim banaya aur yeh kya?" Pas Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, "Main ne tera seena khol nahi diya aur tera bojh hata nahi diya? Aur fulaan aur fulaan ehsan tere upar nahi kiye?" Aur digar aise aise ehsan bataye ke tumhare samne un ke bayan ki mujhe ijazat nahi. Isi ka bayan in aayato mein, aayat: (Thumma dana fatadalla) (An-Najm: 8), mein hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne meri aankho ka noor mere dil mein paida kar diya aur main ne Allah Ta'ala ko apne dil se dekha. Is ki isnad zaeif hai. Upar Utbah bin Abu Lahab ka yeh kehna ke "Main is qareeb aane aur nazdeek hone wale ko nahi manta" aur phir Huzoor ﷺ ka us ke liye bad-dua karna aur sher ka use phaad khana bayan ho chuka hai. Yeh waqia Zarqa mein ya Sarat mein hua tha aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne paish-goi farma di thi ke yeh is tarah halak hoga. 

Phir An-Hazrat ﷺ ka Hazrat Jibrail ko dobara dekhna bayan ho raha hai jo Meraj wali raat ka waqia hai. Meraj ki hadeethein nihayat tafseel ke sath Surah Subhan ki shuru aayat ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain jin ke dobara yahan warid karne ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh bhi bayan guzar chuka hai ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas Meraj wali raat deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala ke hone ke qayil hain. Ek jamat salaf-o-khalaf ka qaul bhi yahi hai aur sahaba ki bahut si jamatein is ke khilaf hain, isi tarah tabieen aur doosre bhi is ke khilaf hain. Huzoor ﷺ ka Jibrail ko paro samet dekhna waghera is qism ki riwayatein upar guzar chuki hain. Hazrat Aisha se Hazrat Masruq ka poochhna aur aap ka jawab bhi abhi bayan hua hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Siddiqa (R.A) apne is jawab ke baad aayat: (La tudrikuhul-absaru wa huwa yudrikul-absara wa huwal-latiful-khabir) (6:103).

(Al-An'am: 103) ki tilawat ki aur aayat (Ma kana libasharin an yu'tiyahullahul-kitaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqula lin-nasi kunu 'ibadal-li min dunillahi wa lakin kunu rabbaniyyina bima kuntum tu'allimunal-kitaba wa bima kuntum tadrusun) (Al-Imran: 79) ki bhi tilawat farmai ya'ani koi aankh use nahi dekh sakti aur woh sab nigahon ko paliya hai kisi insan se Allah ka kalam karna mumkin nahi haan wahi se ya parde ke peeche se ho to aur baat hai phir farmaya jo tumse kahe ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ko kal ki baat ka ilm tha usne ghalat aur jhoot kaha phir aayat (Innallaha 'indahu 'ilmus-sa'ah) (Luqman: 34) aakhir tak padhi. Aur farmaya jo kahe ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah ki kisi baat ko chhupaliya usne bhi jhoot kaha aur tuhmat bandhi aur phir aayat (Ya ayyuhar-rasulu balligh ma unzila ilaika min rabbika) padhi ya'ani Ae Rasool ﷺ jo tumhari jaanib tumhare Rab ki taraf nazil kiya gaya hai use pahuncha do. Haan Aap ne Hazrat Jibril ko unki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Masruq ne Hazrat Aisha ke samne Surah An-Najm ki aayat (Wahuwa bil-ufuqil-a'la) (An-Najm: 7) aur (Walaqad ra'ahu nazlatan ukhra) (An-Najm: 13) padhin iske jawab mein Umm-ul-Muminin Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya is ummat mein sabse pehle in ayaton ke mutalliq khud Nabi ﷺ se maine sawal kiya tha Aap ne farmaya isse murad mera Hazrat Jibril ko dekhna hai Aap ne sirf do dafa is Aminullah ko unki asli surat mein dekha hai ek martaba aasman se zameen par aate hue us waqt tamam khala unke jism se pur tha yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Shaqiq ne Hazrat Abu Zar se kaha ke agar main Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhta to Aap se ek baat zaroor poochta Hazrat Abu Zar ne kaha kya poochte? Kaha yeh ke Aap ne apne Rab-e-Azzawajal ko dekha hai? Hazrat Abu Zar ne farmaya yeh sawal to khud maine Janab-e-Risalat Maab se kiya tha Aap ne jawab diya ke main ne use noor dekha woh to noor hai main use kaise dekh sakta, Sahih Muslim mein bhi yeh hadith do sanadon se marwi hai dono ke alfazon mein kuch her-pher hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad farmate hain main nahi samajh sakta ke is hadith ki kya taujih karun dil is par mutmain nahi Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Zar se manqul hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne dil se didar kiya hai aankhon se nahi Imam Ibn Khuzaimah farmate hain Abdullah bin Shaqiq aur Hazrat Abu Zar ke darmiyan inqita' hai aur Imam Ibn Jauzi farmate hain mumkin hai Hazrat Abu Zar ka yeh sawal Meraj ke waqia se pehle ka ho aur Huzoor ﷺ ne us waqt yeh jawab diya ho agar yeh sawal Meraj ke baad Aap se kiya jata to zaroor Aap iske jawab mein haan farmate inkar na karte.

Lekin yeh qaul sartapa zaeif hai is liye ke Hazrat Aisha ka sawal qat'an Meraj ke baad tha lekin Aap ka jawab us waqt bhi inkar mein hi raha. Ba'az hazrat ne farmaya ke un se khitab un ke aql ke mutabiq kiya gaya ya yeh ke un ka yeh khayal ghalat hai chunacha Ibn Khuzaimah ne Kitab ut-Tauhid mein yahi likha hai drasal yeh mahz khata hai aur bilkul ghalati hai Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas aur Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Allah Ta'ala ko dil se to dekha hai lekin apni aankhon se nahi dekha haan Hazrat Jibril ko apni aankhon se un ki asli surat mein do martaba dekha hai. Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par us waqt farishte ba-kasrat thay aur Noor-e-Rabbani us par jagmaga raha tha aur qism qism ke rang jinhein siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke aur koi nahi jaan sakta, Hazrat Ibn Masood farmate hain Meraj wali raat An-Hazrat ﷺ Sidrat-ul-Muntaha tak pohnchay jo saatwein aasman par hai zameen se jo cheezein charhti hain woh yahin tak charhti hain phir yahan se utha li jati hain isi tarah jo cheezein Allah ki taraf se nazil hoti hain yahin tak pohnchti hain phir yahan se pohnchayi jati hain us waqt us darakht par sone ki tiddiyan ladi hui thin, Huzoor ﷺ ko wahan teen cheezein ata farmayi gayin panchoun waqt ki namazein Surah Al-Baqarah ki khatimah ki aayatein aur Aap ki ummat mein se jo mushrik na ho us ke gunahon ki bakhshish (Muslim). Abu Huraira se ya kisi aur Sahabi se riwayat hai ke jis tarah koye kisi darakht ko gher lete hain usi tarah us waqt Sidrat-ul-Muntaha par farishte cha rahay thay wahan jab Huzoor ﷺ pohnchay to Aap se kaha gaya ke jo mangna ho mango. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain is darakht ki shakhien marwarid, yaqut aur zabarjad ki thin An-Hazrat ﷺ ne isay dekha aur apne dil ki aankhon se Allah ki bhi ziyarat ki. Ibn Zaid farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke Aap ne Sidra par kya dekha? Aap ne farmaya isay sone ki tiddiyan dhanke hue thin aur har ek pattay par ek ek farishta khada hua Allah ki tasbeeh kar raha tha. Aap ki nigahein dayein bayein nahi huin jis cheez ke dekhne ka hukum tha wahin lagi rahein. Sabit-qadami aur kamil ita'at ki yeh poori daleel hai ke jo hukum tha wahi baja laye jo diye gaye wahi lekar khush hue isi ko ek nazm ne tareefan kaha hai. Aap ne Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Linnuriyaka min ayatina-l-kubra 20:23) is liye ke hum tujhe apni badi badi nishaniyan dikhayein jo hamari kamil qudrat aur zabardast azmat par daleel ban jayein. In dono aayaton ko daleel bana kar Ahl-e-Sunnat ka mazhab hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne us raat Allah ka deedar apni aankhon se nahi kiya kyunke irshad-e-bari hai ke Aap ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhein, agar khud Allah ka deedar hua hota to usi deedar ka zikr hota aur logon par se isay zahir kiya jata. Ibn Masood ka qaul guzar chuka hai ke ek martaba Aap ki khwahish par doosri dafa aasman par charhtay waqt Jibril ko Aap ne un ki asli surat mein dekha.

Pas jabkeh Jibraeel ne apne Rabb-e-Azzawajal ko khabar di apni asli surat mein aud kar gaye aur sajda ada kiya, pas Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke paas dobaara dekhne se unhi ka dekhna murad hai yeh riwayat Musnad Ahmad mein hai aur ghareeb hai.)))))))))

Butkade kya thay? In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ko dant raha hai ke woh buton ki aur Allah ke siva doosron ki parastish karte hain aur jis tarah Khalilullah ne bi-hukm-e-Allah Baitullah banaya hai yeh log apne apne ma'بودan-e-batil ke parastish-kade bana rahe hain. Lat ek safed patthar munqash tha jis par qubbah bana rakha tha, ghilaf charhaye jaate thay, mujawir, muhafiz aur jarub-kash muqarrar thay, uske aas-paas ki jagah misl-e-Haram ki hurmat aur buzurgi wali jaante thay, Ahl-e-Taif ka yeh but-kada tha, qabila Saqif uska pujari aur uska mutawalli tha. Quraish ke siva baqi aur sab par yeh log apna fakhr jataya karte thay. Ibn Jareer farmate hain, in logon ne lafz 'Allah' se lafz 'Lat' banaya tha, goya uska muannas banaya tha, Allah ki zaat tamam shareekon se paak hai. Aik qirat mein lafz 'Lat' ta ki tashdeed ke sath hai yaani gholne wala, usse Lat is ma'na mein isliye kehte thay ke yeh ek naik shakhs tha, mausam-e-hajj mein hajiyon ko satu ghol-ghol kar pilata tha, uske inteqal ke baad logon ne uski qabr par mujawarat shuru kar di, rafta-rafta usi ki ibadat karne lage. Isi tarah lafz 'Uzza' lafz 'Azeez' se liya gaya hai, Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan Nakhla mein yeh ek darakht tha, us par bhi qubbah bana hua tha, chadrein charhi hui thin, Quraish uski azmat karte thay. Abu Sufiyan ne Uhad wale din bhi kaha tha: "Hamara Uzza hai aur tumhara nahi," jiske jawab mein Huzoor ﷺ ne kahlwaya tha: "Allah hamara wali hai aur tumhara koi nahi." Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jo shakhs Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe, use chahiye ke foran 'La ilaha illallah' keh le aur jo apne sathi se keh de ke aa juwa khelein, use sadaqa karna chahiye. Matlab yeh hai ke Jahiliyat ke zamane mein kyunki usi ki qasam khai jati thi, toh ab Islam ke baad agar kisi ki zaban se agli aadat ke muwafiq yeh alfaaz nikal jayen, toh use kalma parh lena chahiye. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas aik martaba isi tarah Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe jis par logon ne unhein mutanabbi kiya, yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke paas gaye, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer) parh lo aur teen martaba 'A'uzubillahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem' parh kar apni bayen janib thook do aur آئندہ se aisa na karna. Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan Qadeed ke paas Mushallal mein Manat tha. Qabila Khuza'ah, Aus aur Khazraj Jahiliyat mein iski bohat azmat karte thay, yahin se ahram bandh kar woh Hajj-e-Ka'bah ke liye jaate thay. Isi tarah in teen ki shohrat bohat zyada thi, isliye yahan sirf in teen ka hi bayan farmaya. In maqamat ka yeh log tawaf bhi karte thay, qurbaniyon ke janwar wahan le jaate thay, unke naam par janwar charhaye jaate thay, bawajood iske yeh sab log Ka'bah ki hurmat aur azmat ke qayil thay, اسے Masjid-e-Ibrahimi maante thay aur iski khatir-khwah toqeer karte thay. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke Quraish aur Banu Kinanah Uzza ke pujari thay jo Nakhla mein tha.

Us ka nigehban aur mutawalli qabeela Banu Shaibaan tha jo qabeela Sulaim ki shaakh tha aur Banu Hashim ke sath un ka bhai chara tha. Is but ke torne ke liye Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Fath-e-Makkah ke baad Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed ko bheja tha jinho ne isse tukray tukray kar diya tha aur kehte jaate thay:
Ya Uzza kufranki la subhanki inni ra'aytullaha qad ahanak (A'y Uzza! Main tera munkir hoon, teri paaki bayaan karne wala nahi hoon, mera iman hai ki teri izzat ko Allah ne khaak mein mila diya).
Yeh babool ke teen drakhton par tha, kaat daale gaye aur qubba dha diya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko itlaa di. Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne kuch nahi kiya, laut kar phir dobarah jao."
Hazrat Khalid ke dobarah tashreef le jaane par wahan ke muhafiz aur khuddam ne bare bare makro-fareeb kiye aur khoob ghul macha macha kar "Ya Uzza, Ya Uzza" ke naare lagaye. Hazrat Khalid ne jo dekha to maloom hua ki ek nangi aurat hai jis ke baal bikhre hue hain aur apne sar par mitti daal rahi hai. Aap ne talwar ke ek hi waar mein is ka kaam tamam kiya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar di. Aap ne farmaya: "Uzza yehi thi."

Laat qabeela Thaqeef ka but tha jo Taif mein tha. Is ki tawliyat aur mujawarat Banu Ma'tab mein thi. Yahan is ke dhane ke liye Nabi ﷺ ne Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ko bheja tha jinho ne isse ma'doom kar ke is ki jagah masjid bana di.

Manat Aus o Khazraj aur is ke ham-khayal logon ka but tha. Yeh Mushallal ki taraf se samundar ke kinare Qadeed mein tha. Yahan bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Sufyan ko bheja tha aur Aap ne is ke reze reze kar diye thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ki Hazrat Ali ke hathon yeh kufristan fana hua.

Zul-Khalasah naami but-khanah Daws aur Khash'am aur Bajilah ka tha aur jo log is ke ham-watan thay, yeh Tabalah mein tha aur ise yeh log Ka'bah Yamaniyah kehte thay aur Makkah ke Ka'bah ko Ka'bah Shamiya kehte thay. Yeh Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah ke hathon Rasoolullah ﷺ ke hukum se fana hua.

Fals naami but-khanah qabeela Tai aur un ke aas paas ke arbon ka tha. Yeh Jabal-e-Tai mein Salma aur Aja ke darmiyan tha. Is ke torne par Hazrat Ali mamoor hue thay, Aap ne isse tor diya tha aur yahan se do talwarein le gaye thay: ek Rasoub, doosri Makhzam. An-Hazrat ﷺ ne yeh dono talwarein unhi ko de di thin.

Qabeela Himyar Ahl-e-Yaman ne apna but-khanah Sana'a mein Riyaam naami bana rakha tha. Mazkoor hai ki is mein ek siyah kutta tha aur woh do Himyari jo Tubba ke sath nikle thay, unho ne isse nikaal kar qatl kar diya tha aur is but-khanay ki eent se eent baja di thi.

Aur Raza naami but-kadah Banu Rabee'ah bin Sa'd ka tha. Is ko Mustawghir bin Rabee'ah bin Ka'bah bin Asad ne Islam mein dhaya tha. Ibn Hisham farmate hain ki un ki umr teen sau bees saal ki hui thi jis ka bayaan khud unho ne apne ash'ar mein kiya hai.

Zul-Ka'baat naami sanam-khanah Bakr, Taghlab aur Iyad qabeile ka Sindaad mein tha.

Phir farmata hai: "Kya tumhare liye larke hon aur Allah ki larkiyan hon?"

Kyunke mushrikeen apne zaim-e-batil mein farishton ko Allah ki larkiyan samajhte thay to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai agar tum aapas mein taqseem karo aur kisi ko sirf larkiyan aur kisi ko sirf larke do to woh bhi raazi na hoga aur yeh taqseem namunsafi ki samjhi jayegi che jaike tum Allah ke liye larkiyan sabit karo aur khud tum apne liye larke pasand karo phir farmata hai in ko tum ne apni taraf se baghair kisi daleel ke mazboot thehra kar jo chaha naam ghar liya hai warna na woh mabood hain na kisi aise pak naam ke mustahiq hain khud yeh log bhi in ki pooja paat par koi daleel paish nahi kar sakte sirf apne baron par husn-e-zann rakh kar jo unho ne kiya tha yeh bhi kar rahe hain makhi par makhi marte chale jaate hain museebat to yeh hai ke daleel aa jaane Allah ki baatein wazeh ho jaane ke bawajood bhi baap dada ki ghalat raah ko nahi chhodte. Phir farmata hai kya har insan tamanna par tumhare liye kya likha jayega? Tamam umoor ka malik Allah Ta'ala hai duniya aur aakhirat mein tasarruf usi ka hai jo is ne jo chaha ho raha hai aur jo chahega hoga. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ki ijazat ke baghair koi bare se bara farishta bhi kisi ke liye sifarish ka lafz bhi nahi nikal sakta. Jaise farmaya ayat (Man zal-lazi yuqridul-laha qardan hasanan fayudaifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareem) (Al-Hadid: 11) Kaun hai jo us ke paas us ki ijazat ke baghair sifarish paish kar sake us ke farman ke baghair kisi ko kisi ki sifarish nafa nahi de sakti. In ki parastish se Allah rok raha hai tamam Rusool ﷺ aur kul aasmani kitabein Allah ke siva auron ki ibadat se rokna apna azeem-ush-shan maqsad batati hain phir tum in ko apna sifarishi samajh rahe ho kis qadr ghalat raah hai.

Kyunke mushrikeen apne zaim-e-batil mein farishton ko Allah ki larkiyan samajhte thay to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai agar tum aapas mein taqseem karo aur kisi ko sirf larkiyan aur kisi ko sirf larke do to woh bhi raazi na hoga aur yeh taqseem namunsafi ki samjhi jayegi che jaike tum Allah ke liye larkiyan sabit karo aur khud tum apne liye larke pasand karo phir farmata hai in ko tum ne apni taraf se baghair kisi daleel ke mazboot thehra kar jo chaha naam ghar liya hai warna na woh mabood hain na kisi aise pak naam ke mustahiq hain khud yeh log bhi in ki pooja paat par koi daleel paish nahi kar sakte sirf apne baron par husn-e-zann rakh kar jo unho ne kiya tha yeh bhi kar rahe hain makhi par makhi marte chale jaate hain museebat to yeh hai ke daleel aa jaane Allah ki baatein wazeh ho jaane ke bawajood bhi baap dada ki ghalat raah ko nahi chhodte. Phir farmata hai kya har insan tamanna par tumhare liye kya likha jayega? Tamam umoor ka malik Allah Ta'ala hai duniya aur aakhirat mein tasarruf usi ka hai jo is ne jo chaha ho raha hai aur jo chahega hoga. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ki ijazat ke baghair koi bare se bara farishta bhi kisi ke liye sifarish ka lafz bhi nahi nikal sakta. Jaise farmaya ayat (Man zal-lazi yuqridul-laha qardan hasanan fayudaifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareem) (Al-Hadid: 11) Kaun hai jo us ke paas us ki ijazat ke baghair sifarish paish kar sake us ke farman ke baghair kisi ko kisi ki sifarish nafa nahi de sakti. Jabke bare bare qareebi farishton ka yeh haal hai to phir ae na-wafqo! Tumhare yeh but aur thaan kya nafa pohncha denge? In ki parastish se Allah rok raha hai tamam Rusool ﷺ aur kul aasmani kitabein Allah ke siva auron ki ibadat se rokna apna azeem-ush-shan maqsad batati hain phir tum in ko apna sifarishi samajh rahe ho kis qadr ghalat raah hai.

Butkade kya thay? In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ko dant raha hai ke woh buton ki aur Allah ke siva doosron ki parastish karte hain aur jis tarah Khalilullah ne bi-hukm-e-Allah Baitullah banaya hai yeh log apne apne ma'بودan-e-batil ke parastish-kade bana rahe hain. Lat ek safed patthar munqash tha jis par qubbah bana rakha tha, ghilaf charhaye jaate thay, mujawir, muhafiz aur jarub-kash muqarrar thay, uske aas-paas ki jagah misl-e-Haram ki hurmat aur buzurgi wali jaante thay, Ahl-e-Taif ka yeh but-kada tha, qabila Saqif uska pujari aur uska mutawalli tha. Quraish ke siva baqi aur sab par yeh log apna fakhr jataya karte thay. Ibn Jareer farmate hain, in logon ne lafz 'Allah' se lafz 'Lat' banaya tha, goya uska muannas banaya tha, Allah ki zaat tamam shareekon se paak hai. Aik qirat mein lafz 'Lat' ta ki tashdeed ke sath hai yaani gholne wala, usse Lat is ma'na mein isliye kehte thay ke yeh ek naik shakhs tha, mausam-e-hajj mein hajiyon ko satu ghol-ghol kar pilata tha, uske inteqal ke baad logon ne uski qabr par mujawarat shuru kar di, rafta-rafta usi ki ibadat karne lage. Isi tarah lafz 'Uzza' lafz 'Azeez' se liya gaya hai, Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan Nakhla mein yeh ek darakht tha, us par bhi qubbah bana hua tha, chadrein charhi hui thin, Quraish uski azmat karte thay. Abu Sufiyan ne Uhad wale din bhi kaha tha: "Hamara Uzza hai aur tumhara nahi," jiske jawab mein Huzoor ﷺ ne kahlwaya tha: "Allah hamara wali hai aur tumhara koi nahi." Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jo shakhs Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe, use chahiye ke foran 'La ilaha illallah' keh le aur jo apne sathi se keh de ke aa juwa khelein, use sadaqa karna chahiye. Matlab yeh hai ke Jahiliyat ke zamane mein kyunki usi ki qasam khai jati thi, toh ab Islam ke baad agar kisi ki zaban se agli aadat ke muwafiq yeh alfaaz nikal jayen, toh use kalma parh lena chahiye. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas aik martaba isi tarah Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe jis par logon ne unhein mutanabbi kiya, yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke paas gaye, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer) parh lo aur teen martaba 'A'uzubillahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem' parh kar apni bayen janib thook do aur آئندہ se aisa na karna. Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan Qadeed ke paas Mushallal mein Manat tha. Qabila Khuza'ah, Aus aur Khazraj Jahiliyat mein iski bohat azmat karte thay, yahin se ahram bandh kar woh Hajj-e-Ka'bah ke liye jaate thay. Isi tarah in teen ki shohrat bohat zyada thi, isliye yahan sirf in teen ka hi bayan farmaya. In maqamat ka yeh log tawaf bhi karte thay, qurbaniyon ke janwar wahan le jaate thay, unke naam par janwar charhaye jaate thay, bawajood iske yeh sab log Ka'bah ki hurmat aur azmat ke qayil thay, اسے Masjid-e-Ibrahimi maante thay aur iski khatir-khwah toqeer karte thay. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke Quraish aur Banu Kinanah Uzza ke pujari thay jo Nakhla mein tha.

Us ka nigehban aur mutawalli qabeela Banu Shaibaan tha jo qabeela Sulaim ki shaakh tha aur Banu Hashim ke sath un ka bhai chara tha. Is but ke torne ke liye Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Fath-e-Makkah ke baad Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed ko bheja tha jinho ne isse tukray tukray kar diya tha aur kehte jaate thay:
Ya Uzza kufranki la subhanki inni ra'aytullaha qad ahanak (A'y Uzza! Main tera munkir hoon, teri paaki bayaan karne wala nahi hoon, mera iman hai ki teri izzat ko Allah ne khaak mein mila diya).
Yeh babool ke teen drakhton par tha, kaat daale gaye aur qubba dha diya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko itlaa di. Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne kuch nahi kiya, laut kar phir dobarah jao."
Hazrat Khalid ke dobarah tashreef le jaane par wahan ke muhafiz aur khuddam ne bare bare makro-fareeb kiye aur khoob ghul macha macha kar "Ya Uzza, Ya Uzza" ke naare lagaye. Hazrat Khalid ne jo dekha to maloom hua ki ek nangi aurat hai jis ke baal bikhre hue hain aur apne sar par mitti daal rahi hai. Aap ne talwar ke ek hi waar mein is ka kaam tamam kiya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar di. Aap ne farmaya: "Uzza yehi thi."

Laat qabeela Thaqeef ka but tha jo Taif mein tha. Is ki tawliyat aur mujawarat Banu Ma'tab mein thi. Yahan is ke dhane ke liye Nabi ﷺ ne Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ko bheja tha jinho ne isse ma'doom kar ke is ki jagah masjid bana di.

Manat Aus o Khazraj aur is ke ham-khayal logon ka but tha. Yeh Mushallal ki taraf se samundar ke kinare Qadeed mein tha. Yahan bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Sufyan ko bheja tha aur Aap ne is ke reze reze kar diye thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ki Hazrat Ali ke hathon yeh kufristan fana hua.

Zul-Khalasah naami but-khanah Daws aur Khash'am aur Bajilah ka tha aur jo log is ke ham-watan thay, yeh Tabalah mein tha aur ise yeh log Ka'bah Yamaniyah kehte thay aur Makkah ke Ka'bah ko Ka'bah Shamiya kehte thay. Yeh Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah ke hathon Rasoolullah ﷺ ke hukum se fana hua.

Fals naami but-khanah qabeela Tai aur un ke aas paas ke arbon ka tha. Yeh Jabal-e-Tai mein Salma aur Aja ke darmiyan tha. Is ke torne par Hazrat Ali mamoor hue thay, Aap ne isse tor diya tha aur yahan se do talwarein le gaye thay: ek Rasoub, doosri Makhzam. An-Hazrat ﷺ ne yeh dono talwarein unhi ko de di thin.

Qabeela Himyar Ahl-e-Yaman ne apna but-khanah Sana'a mein Riyaam naami bana rakha tha. Mazkoor hai ki is mein ek siyah kutta tha aur woh do Himyari jo Tubba ke sath nikle thay, unho ne isse nikaal kar qatl kar diya tha aur is but-khanay ki eent se eent baja di thi.

Aur Raza naami but-kadah Banu Rabee'ah bin Sa'd ka tha. Is ko Mustawghir bin Rabee'ah bin Ka'bah bin Asad ne Islam mein dhaya tha. Ibn Hisham farmate hain ki un ki umr teen sau bees saal ki hui thi jis ka bayaan khud unho ne apne ash'ar mein kiya hai.

Zul-Ka'baat naami sanam-khanah Bakr, Taghlab aur Iyad qabeile ka Sindaad mein tha.

Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke Quraish aur Banu Kinanah Uzza ke pujari thay jo Nakhla mein tha.

Hazrat Khalid ne jo dekha to maloom hua ki ek nangi aurat hai jis ke baal bikhre hue hain aur apne sar par mitti daal rahi hai. Aap ne talwar ke ek hi waar mein is ka kaam tamam kiya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar di. Aap ne farmaya: "Uzza yehi thi."

Manat Aus o Khazraj aur is ke ham-khayal logon ka but tha. Yeh Mushallal ki taraf se samundar ke kinare Qadeed mein tha. Yahan bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Sufyan ko bheja tha aur Aap ne is ke reze reze kar diye thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ki Hazrat Ali ke hathon yeh kufristan fana hua.

Zul-Khalasah naami but-khanah Daws aur Khash'am aur Bajilah ka tha aur jo log is ke ham-watan thay, yeh Tabalah mein tha aur ise yeh log Ka'bah Yamaniyah kehte thay aur Makkah ke Ka'bah ko Ka'bah Shamiya kehte thay. Yeh Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah ke hathon Rasoolullah ﷺ ke hukum se fana hua.

Zul-Ka'baat naami sanam-khanah Bakr, Taghlab aur Iyad qabeile ka Sindaad mein tha.

Jaise farmaya ayat (Man zal-lazi yuqridul-laha qardan hasanan fayudaifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareem) (Al-Hadid: 11) Kaun hai jo us ke paas us ki ijazat ke baghair sifarish paish kar sake us ke farman ke baghair kisi ko kisi ki sifarish nafa nahi de sakti. Jabke bare bare qareebi farishton ka yeh haal hai to phir ae na-wafqo! Tumhare yeh but aur thaan kya nafa pohncha denge? In ki parastish se Allah rok raha hai tamam Rusool ﷺ aur kul aasmani kitabein Allah ke siva auron ki ibadat se rokna apna azeem-ush-shan maqsad batati hain phir tum in ko apna sifarishi samajh rahe ho kis qadr ghalat raah hai.

Butkade kya thay? In ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ko dant raha hai ke woh buton ki aur Allah ke siva doosron ki parastish karte hain aur jis tarah Khalilullah ne bi-hukm-e-Allah Baitullah banaya hai yeh log apne apne ma'بودan-e-batil ke parastish-kade bana rahe hain. Lat ek safed patthar munqash tha jis par qubbah bana rakha tha, ghilaf charhaye jaate thay, mujawir, muhafiz aur jarub-kash muqarrar thay, uske aas-paas ki jagah misl-e-Haram ki hurmat aur buzurgi wali jaante thay, Ahl-e-Taif ka yeh but-kada tha, qabila Saqif uska pujari aur uska mutawalli tha. Quraish ke siva baqi aur sab par yeh log apna fakhr jataya karte thay. Ibn Jareer farmate hain, in logon ne lafz 'Allah' se lafz 'Lat' banaya tha, goya uska muannas banaya tha, Allah ki zaat tamam shareekon se paak hai. Aik qirat mein lafz 'Lat' ta ki tashdeed ke sath hai yaani gholne wala, usse Lat is ma'na mein isliye kehte thay ke yeh ek naik shakhs tha, mausam-e-hajj mein hajiyon ko satu ghol-ghol kar pilata tha, uske inteqal ke baad logon ne uski qabr par mujawarat shuru kar di, rafta-rafta usi ki ibadat karne lage. Isi tarah lafz 'Uzza' lafz 'Azeez' se liya gaya hai, Makkah aur Taif ke darmiyan Nakhla mein yeh ek darakht tha, us par bhi qubbah bana hua tha, chadrein charhi hui thin, Quraish uski azmat karte thay. Abu Sufiyan ne Uhad wale din bhi kaha tha: "Hamara Uzza hai aur tumhara nahi," jiske jawab mein Huzoor ﷺ ne kahlwaya tha: "Allah hamara wali hai aur tumhara koi nahi." Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke jo shakhs Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe, use chahiye ke foran 'La ilaha illallah' keh le aur jo apne sathi se keh de ke aa juwa khelein, use sadaqa karna chahiye. Matlab yeh hai ke Jahiliyat ke zamane mein kyunki usi ki qasam khai jati thi, toh ab Islam ke baad agar kisi ki zaban se agli aadat ke muwafiq yeh alfaaz nikal jayen, toh use kalma parh lena chahiye. Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas aik martaba isi tarah Lat-o-Uzza ki qasam kha baithe jis par logon ne unhein mutanabbi kiya, yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke paas gaye, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Dua (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer) parh lo aur teen martaba 'A'uzubillahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem' parh kar apni bayen janib thook do aur آئندہ se aisa na karna. Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan Qadeed ke paas Mushallal mein Manat tha. Qabila Khuza'ah, Aus aur Khazraj Jahiliyat mein iski bohat azmat karte thay, yahin se ahram bandh kar woh Hajj-e-Ka'bah ke liye jaate thay. Isi tarah in teen ki shohrat bohat zyada thi, isliye yahan sirf in teen ka hi bayan farmaya. In maqamat ka yeh log tawaf bhi karte thay, qurbaniyon ke janwar wahan le jaate thay, unke naam par janwar charhaye jaate thay, bawajood iske yeh sab log Ka'bah ki hurmat aur azmat ke qayil thay, اسے Masjid-e-Ibrahimi maante thay aur iski khatir-khwah toqeer karte thay. Sirat Ibn Ishaq mein hai ke Quraish aur Banu Kinanah Uzza ke pujari thay jo Nakhla mein tha.

Us ka nigehban aur mutawalli qabeela Banu Shaibaan tha jo qabeela Sulaim ki shaakh tha aur Banu Hashim ke sath un ka bhai chara tha. Is but ke torne ke liye Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Fath-e-Makkah ke baad Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed ko bheja tha jinho ne isse tukray tukray kar diya tha aur kehte jaate thay:
Ya Uzza kufranki la subhanki inni ra'aytullaha qad ahanak (A'y Uzza! Main tera munkir hoon, teri paaki bayaan karne wala nahi hoon, mera iman hai ki teri izzat ko Allah ne khaak mein mila diya).
Yeh babool ke teen drakhton par tha, kaat daale gaye aur qubba dha diya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko itlaa di. Aap ne farmaya: "Tum ne kuch nahi kiya, laut kar phir dobarah jao."
Hazrat Khalid ke dobarah tashreef le jaane par wahan ke muhafiz aur khuddam ne bare bare makro-fareeb kiye aur khoob ghul macha macha kar "Ya Uzza, Ya Uzza" ke naare lagaye. Hazrat Khalid ne jo dekha to maloom hua ki ek nangi aurat hai jis ke baal bikhre hue hain aur apne sar par mitti daal rahi hai. Aap ne talwar ke ek hi waar mein is ka kaam tamam kiya aur wapas aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar di. Aap ne farmaya: "Uzza yehi thi."

Laat qabeela Thaqeef ka but tha jo Taif mein tha. Is ki tawliyat aur mujawarat Banu Ma'tab mein thi. Yahan is ke dhane ke liye Nabi ﷺ ne Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan Sakhr bin Harb ko bheja tha jinho ne isse ma'doom kar ke is ki jagah masjid bana di.

Manat Aus o Khazraj aur is ke ham-khayal logon ka but tha. Yeh Mushallal ki taraf se samundar ke kinare Qadeed mein tha. Yahan bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Sufyan ko bheja tha aur Aap ne is ke reze reze kar diye thay. Baaz ka qaul hai ki Hazrat Ali ke hathon yeh kufristan fana hua.

Zul-Khalasah naami but-khanah Daws aur Khash'am aur Bajilah ka tha aur jo log is ke ham-watan thay, yeh Tabalah mein tha aur ise yeh log Ka'bah Yamaniyah kehte thay aur Makkah ke Ka'bah ko Ka'bah Shamiya kehte thay. Yeh Hazrat Jareer bin Abdullah ke hathon Rasoolullah ﷺ ke hukum se fana hua.

Fals naami but-khanah qabeela Tai aur un ke aas paas ke arbon ka tha. Yeh Jabal-e-Tai mein Salma aur Aja ke darmiyan tha. Is ke torne par Hazrat Ali mamoor hue thay, Aap ne isse tor diya tha aur yahan se do talwarein le gaye thay: ek Rasoub, doosri Makhzam. An-Hazrat ﷺ ne yeh dono talwarein unhi ko de di thin.

Qabeela Himyar Ahl-e-Yaman ne apna but-khanah Sana'a mein Riyaam naami bana rakha tha. Mazkoor hai ki is mein ek siyah kutta tha aur woh do Himyari jo Tubba ke sath nikle thay, unho ne isse nikaal kar qatl kar diya tha aur is but-khanay ki eent se eent baja di thi.

Aur Raza naami but-kadah Banu Rabee'ah bin Sa'd ka tha. Is ko Mustawghir bin Rabee'ah bin Ka'bah bin Asad ne Islam mein dhaya tha. Ibn Hisham farmate hain ki un ki umr teen sau bees saal ki hui thi jis ka bayaan khud unho ne apne ash'ar mein kiya hai.

Zul-Ka'baat naami sanam-khanah Bakr, Taghlab aur Iyad qabeile ka Sindaad mein tha.

Phir farmata hai: "Kya tumhare liye larke hon aur Allah ki larkiyan hon?"

Kyunke mushrikeen apne zaim-e-batil mein farishton ko Allah ki larkiyan samajhte thay to Allah Ta'ala farmata hai agar tum aapas mein taqseem karo aur kisi ko sirf larkiyan aur kisi ko sirf larke do to woh bhi raazi na hoga aur yeh taqseem namunsafi ki samjhi jayegi che jaike tum Allah ke liye larkiyan sabit karo aur khud tum apne liye larke pasand karo phir farmata hai in ko tum ne apni taraf se baghair kisi daleel ke mazboot thehra kar jo chaha naam ghar liya hai warna na woh mabood hain na kisi aise pak naam ke mustahiq hain khud yeh log bhi in ki pooja paat par koi daleel paish nahi kar sakte sirf apne baron par husn-e-zann rakh kar jo unho ne kiya tha yeh bhi kar rahe hain makhi par makhi marte chale jaate hain museebat to yeh hai ke daleel aa jaane Allah ki baatein wazeh ho jaane ke bawajood bhi baap dada ki ghalat raah ko nahi chhodte. Phir farmata hai kya har insan tamanna par tumhare liye kya likha jayega? Phir farmata hai ke Allah ki ijazat ke baghair koi bare se bara farishta bhi kisi ke liye sifarish ka lafz bhi nahi nikal sakta. Jabke bare bare qareebi farishton ka yeh haal hai to phir ae na-wafqo! Tumhare yeh but aur thaan kya nafa pohncha denge? In ki parastish se Allah rok raha hai tamam Rusool ﷺ aur kul aasmani kitabein Allah ke siva auron ki ibadat se rokna apna azeem-ush-shan maqsad batati hain phir tum in ko apna sifarishi samajh rahe ho kis qadr ghalat raah hai.

Akhirat ka ghar aur duniya 

Allah Ta'ala mushrikin ke is qoul ki tardeed farmata hai ke Allah ke farishte us ki larkiyan hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Waja'ul-mala'ikatal-lazina hum 'ibadur-rahmani inatha, ashahidu khalqahum, satuktabu shahadatum wa yus'alun) (Az-Zukhruf: 19), yani Allah ke maqbool bandon aur farishton ko unhon ne Allah ki larkiyan thehra diya hai kya un ki paidaish ke waqt yeh mojood the? Un ki shahadat likhi jayegi aur un se pursish ki jayegi. 

Yahan bhi farmaya ke yeh log farishton ke zanana naam rakhte hain jo un ki be-ilmi ka nateeja hai, mahz jhoot, khula buhtan, balkey sareeh shirk hai. Yeh sirf un ki atkal hai aur yeh zahir hai ke atkal-pachoo ki baatein haq ke qaim-maqam nahi hosaktin. 

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai: Guman se bacho, guman badtareen jhoot hai. 

Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ se farmata hai ke haq se i'raz karne walon se aap bhi i'raz kar len. Un ka matmae nazar sirf duniya ki zindagi hai aur jis ki ghayat yeh sufli duniya ho us ka anjam kabhi nek nahi hota. Un ke ilm ki ghayat bhi yahi hai ke duniya talbi aur koshish duniya mein har waqt munhamik rahen. 

Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain: Duniya us ka ghar hai jis ka (akhirat mein) ghar na ho aur duniya us ka maal hai jis ka maal (akhirat mein) kangal na ho. 

Ek manqool dua mein Huzoor ﷺ ke yeh alfaaz bhi aaye hain: (Allahumma la taj'alid-dunya akbara hamna wa la mablagha 'ilmina), parvardigar to hamari aham-tar koshish aur matmae nazar aur maqsad-e-maloomat sirf duniya hi ko na kar. 

Phir farmata hai ke jamee' makhlooqaat ka khaliq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai, apne bandon ki maslihaton se sahih taur par wahi waqif hai, jise chahe hidayat de, jise chahe zalalat de, sab kuch us ki qudrat, ilm aur hikmat se ho raha hai. Woh adil hai apni shariat mein aur andaza muqarrar karne mein, zulm aur be-insafi nahi karta.

Gunah aur Zabita-e-Ilahi:
Malik-e-Aasman-o-Zameen, be-parwah-e-mutlaq, shahanshah-e-haqiqi, adil, khaliq-e-haq-o-haq-kar Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Har kisi ko us ke aamal ka badla dene wala, neki par naik jaza aur badi par buri saza dene wala hai. Us ke nazdeek bhale log woh hain jo us ki haram kardah cheezon aur kaamo se, bare bare gunahon aur badkariyon o nalaiqiyon se alag rahein. Un se ba-taqaza-e-bashriyat agar kabhi koi chota sa gunah sarzad ho bhi jaye to Parvardigar parda-poshi karta hai aur maaf farma deta hai, jaise aur ayat mein hai:
(In tajtanibu kaba-ira ma tunhawna anhu nukaffir ankum sayyi-atikum wa nudkhilkum mudkalan karima) (An-Nisa: 31)
"Agar tum in kabira gunahon se pak-daman rahe jin se tumhein rok diya gaya hai to hum tumhari buraiyan maaf farma denge."
Yahan bhi farmaya magar choti choti laghzishein aur insaniyat ki kamzoriyan maaf hain. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain lam ki تفسیر (tafsir) mere khayal mein Hazrat Abu Huraira ki bayan kardah is hadith se zyada achhi koi nahi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn Adam par us ka zina ka hissa likh diya hai jise woh yaqinan pa kar hi rahega. Ankhon ka zina dekhna hai, zubaan ka zina bolna hai, dil umang aur aarzu karta hai, ab sharmgah khwah use sacha kar dikhaye ya jhoota (Bukhari o Muslim).
Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud farmate hain ankhon ka zina nazar karna hai aur honton ka bosa lena hai aur hathon ka zina pakadna hai aur pairon ka zina chalna hai aur sharmgah use sacha karti hai ya jhoota kar deti hai, yaani agar sharmgah ko na rok saka aur badkari kar baitha toh sab aaza ka zina sabit aur agar apne is uzw ko rok liya toh woh sab lam mein dakhil hai.
Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke lam bosa lena, chhedna, dekhna, mass karna hai aur jab sharmgahaein mil gayin toh ghusal wajib ho gaya aur zina-kari ka gunah sabit ho gaya.
Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is jumla ki tafsir yehi marwi hai yani jo pehle guzar chuka.
Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain gunah se aloodgi ho phir chhod de toh lam mein dakhil hai.
Shair kehta hai:
In taghfirillahumma taghfir jamma, Wa ayyu abdin laka ma alama
"Aaye Allah! Jabke tu maaf farmata hai toh sab kuch hi maaf farma de, warna yun alooda-e-isyan toh har insan hai."
Mujahid farmate hain ahl-e-jahiliyat apne tawaf mein umoman is sher ko padha karte thay. Ibn Jareer mein Huzoor ﷺ ka is sher ko padhna bhi marwi hai, Tirmidhi mein bhi ye marwi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih Gharib kehte hain. Bazzar farmate hain humein is ki aur sanad maloom nahi sirf isi sanad se marfu'an marwi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim aur Baghwi ne bhi ise naqal kiya hai, Baghwi ne ise Surah Tanzeel mein riwayat kiya hai lekin is marfu' ki sehat mein nazar hai.

Aik riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya murad yeh hai ke zina se nazdeeki hone ke baad tauba kare aur phir na laute, chori ke qareeb ho jaane ke baad chori na ki aur tauba karke laut aaya, isi tarah sharab peene ke qareeb ho kar sharab na pi aur tauba kar ke laut gaya, yeh sab al-mam hain jo ek Momin ko maaf hain, Hazrat Hasan se bhi yeh mروی hai, ek riwayat mein hai Sahaba se umoman is ka marwi hona bayan kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr farmate hain murad is se shirk ke alawa gunah hain. Ibn Zubair farmate hain do hadon ke darmiyan had-e-zina aur azab-e-akhirat hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke har woh cheez jo do hadon ke darmiyan had-e-dunya aur had-e-akhirat namazein is ka kaffara ban jati hain aur woh har wajib karde-wali se kam hai, had-e-dunya to woh hai jo kisi gunah par Allah ne duniyawi saza muqarrar kardi hai aur us ki saza dunya mein muqarrar nahi ki. Tere Rabb ki bakhshish bahut waseeh hai, har cheez ko gher liya hai aur tamam gunahon par us ka ihata hai jaise farman hai ayat: (Qul ya 'ibadiyalladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah, innallaha yaghfirudh-dunuba jami'an, innahu huwal-ghafoor-ur-raheem) (Az-Zumar: 53) Aye mere woh bando! Jinhon ne apni jaan par israf kiya hai, Allah ki رحمت se na-umeed na hona, Allah Ta'ala tamam gunahon ko bakhsh deta hai aur woh badi bakhshish wala aur bade raham wala hai. Phir farmaya woh tumhein dekhne wala aur tumhare har haal ka ilm rakhne wala aur tumhare har kalam ko sunne wala aur tumhare tamam-tar amaal se waqif hai, jabki us ne tumhare baap Adam ko zameen se paida kiya aur un ki peeth se un ki aulad nikali jo cheention ki tarah phail gayi, phir un ki taqseen kar ke do giroh bana diye ek Jannat ke liye aur ek Jahannam ke liye, aur jab tum apni maa ke pait mein bachche the, us ke muqarrar karde farishte ne rozi, umr, amal, neki, badi likh li, bahut se bachche pait se hi gir jate hain, bahut se doodh peene ki halat mein faut ho jate hain, bahut se doodh chhootne ke baad bulughat se pehle hi chal baste hain, bahut se ain jawani mein daar-e-dunya khaali kar jate hain, ab jabki hum tamam manazil ko tay kar chuke aur budhape mein aa gaye jis ke baad koi manzil maut ke siwa nahi, ab bhi agar hum na sanbhalein toh hum se badh kar ghafil kaun hai? Logon ne kaha phir hum is ka kya naam rakhein? Farmaya Zainab naam rakho.

Abu Dawood aur Muslim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Usman ke samne un ki tareefen bayan karna shuru kar din, is par Hazrat Miqdad bin Aswad us ke munh mein mitti bharne lage aur farmaye hamein Rasool Allah ﷺ ka hukam hai ke tareefen karne walon ke munh mitti se bhar do.

Gunah aur Zabita-e-Ilahi:
Malik-e-Aasman-o-Zameen, be-parwah-e-mutlaq, shahanshah-e-haqiqi, adil, khaliq-e-haq-o-haq-kar Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Har kisi ko us ke aamal ka badla dene wala, neki par naik jaza aur badi par buri saza dene wala hai. Us ke nazdeek bhale log woh hain jo us ki haram kardah cheezon aur kaamo se, bare bare gunahon aur badkariyon o nalaiqiyon se alag rahein. Un se ba-taqaza-e-bashriyat agar kabhi koi chota sa gunah sarzad ho bhi jaye to Parvardigar parda-poshi karta hai aur maaf farma deta hai, jaise aur ayat mein hai:
(In tajtanibu kaba-ira ma tunhawna anhu nukaffir ankum sayyi-atikum wa nudkhilkum mudkalan karima) (An-Nisa: 31)
"Agar tum in kabira gunahon se pak-daman rahe jin se tumhein rok diya gaya hai to hum tumhari buraiyan maaf farma denge."
Yahan bhi farmaya magar choti choti laghzishein aur insaniyat ki kamzoriyan maaf hain. Hazrat Abdullah farmate hain lam ki تفسیر (tafsir) mere khayal mein Hazrat Abu Huraira ki bayan kardah is hadith se zyada achhi koi nahi ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn Adam par us ka zina ka hissa likh diya hai jise woh yaqinan pa kar hi rahega. Ankhon ka zina dekhna hai, zubaan ka zina bolna hai, dil umang aur aarzu karta hai, ab sharmgah khwah use sacha kar dikhaye ya jhoota (Bukhari o Muslim).
Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud farmate hain ankhon ka zina nazar karna hai aur honton ka bosa lena hai aur hathon ka zina pakadna hai aur pairon ka zina chalna hai aur sharmgah use sacha karti hai ya jhoota kar deti hai, yaani agar sharmgah ko na rok saka aur badkari kar baitha toh sab aaza ka zina sabit aur agar apne is uzw ko rok liya toh woh sab lam mein dakhil hai.
Hazrat Abu Huraira se marwi hai ke lam bosa lena, chhedna, dekhna, mass karna hai aur jab sharmgahaein mil gayin toh ghusal wajib ho gaya aur zina-kari ka gunah sabit ho gaya.
Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is jumla ki tafsir yehi marwi hai yani jo pehle guzar chuka.
Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain gunah se aloodgi ho phir chhod de toh lam mein dakhil hai.
Shair kehta hai:
In taghfirillahumma taghfir jamma, Wa ayyu abdin laka ma alama
"Aaye Allah! Jabke tu maaf farmata hai toh sab kuch hi maaf farma de, warna yun alooda-e-isyan toh har insan hai."
Mujahid farmate hain ahl-e-jahiliyat apne tawaf mein umoman is sher ko padha karte thay. Ibn Jareer mein Huzoor ﷺ ka is sher ko padhna bhi marwi hai, Tirmidhi mein bhi ye marwi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih Gharib kehte hain. Bazzar farmate hain humein is ki aur sanad maloom nahi sirf isi sanad se marfu'an marwi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim aur Baghwi ne bhi ise naqal kiya hai, Baghwi ne ise Surah Tanzeel mein riwayat kiya hai lekin is marfu' ki sehat mein nazar hai.

Aik riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya murad yeh hai ke zina se nazdeeki hone ke baad tauba kare aur phir na laute, chori ke qareeb ho jaane ke baad chori na ki aur tauba karke laut aaya, isi tarah sharab peene ke qareeb ho kar sharab na pi aur tauba kar ke laut gaya, yeh sab al-mam hain jo ek Momin ko maaf hain, Hazrat Hasan se bhi yeh mروی hai, ek riwayat mein hai Sahaba se umoman is ka marwi hona bayan kiya gaya hai. Munafiq-o-Kafir ka Nafsiyati Tajziya: Allah Ta'ala un logon ki muzammat kar raha hai jo Allah ki farmanbardari se munh mor lein, sach na kahein, na namaz ada karein, balki jhutlayein, a'raz karein, rah-e-Allah bahut hi kam kharch karein, dil ko naseehat qubool karne wala na banayein, kabhi kuch kehna maan liya phir rasiyan kaat kar alag ho gaye. Arab "akda" us waqt kehte hain maslan kuch log kuan khod rahe hon, darmiyan mein koi sakht chattan ajaye aur woh dastbardar ho jayein. Farmata hai kya us ke paas ilm-e-ghaib hai jis se us ne jaan liya ke agar main rah-e-Lillah apna zar-o-maal doonga to khali hath reh jaunga? Yani darasal yun nahi balki yeh sadqe, neki aur bhalayi se azru-e-bukhl, tama, khud-gharzi, namardi aur be-dili ke ruk raha hai. Hadith mein hai: "Aey Bilal! Kharch kar aur arsh wale se faqeer bana dene ka dar na rakh." Khud Quran mein hai: Wa ma anfaqtum min shai'in fa huwa yukhlifuhu, wa huwa khair-ur-raziqin (Surah (Saba: 39). Tum jo kuch kharch karoge, Allah Ta'ala tumhe us ka badla dega aur wahi behtareen raaziq hai.

Wa fi ke ma'ani ek to yeh kiye gaye hain ke unhein hukum kiya gaya tha woh sab unhein ne pohncha diya, dusre ma'ani yeh kiye gaye hain ke jo hukum mila use baja laye. Theek yeh hai ke yeh dono hi ma'ani durust hain jaisa ke aur ayat mein hai: Wa iz ibtala Ibrahima rabbuhu bi kalimatin fa atmahun (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 124). Ibrahim ko jab kabhi jis kisi azmayish ke sath us ke رب ne azmaya, aap ne kamyabi ke sath is mein number mila liye yani har hukum ko baja laye, har mana se ruke rahe, Rabb ki risalat poori tarah pohncha di, pas Allah ne unhein imam bana kar dusron ka un ka tab-e-dar bana diya jaisa ke irshad hua hai: Summa awhaina ilaika an اتباع millata Ibrahima hanifan wa ma kana minal mushrikin. Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke millat-e-Ibrahim Haneef ki pairwi kar jo mushrik na tha. 

Ibn Jarir ki ek marfoo' hadith mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne is ayat ki tafseer mein farmaya ke har roz woh din nikalte hi chaar rakat ada kiya karte the, yahi un ki wafadari thi. Tirmizi mein ek hadith-e-qudsi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye lafz "wafi" is liye farmaya ke woh har subh-o-sham in kalmaat ko parha karte the: Fa subhanAllahi hina tumsoona wa hina tusbihoon (Surah (Ar-Rum: 17) yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ayat khatam ki.

Phir sagheera ya kabeera kiya to us ka wabaal khud us par hai, us ka yeh bojh koi aur na uthayega. Jaisa ke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai: Wa in tad'u musqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shai'un wa lau kana dha qurba, innama tunzirullazeena yakhshauna rabbahum bil-ghaibi wa aqamus-salata, wa man tazakka fa innama yatazakka linafsih, wa ilallahil-maseer (Surah (Fatir: 18).

(Fatir: 18), Agar koi bojh-ladd apna bojh uthane ke liye kisi ko pukarega, to usmein se kuch bhi na uthaya jayega, khwah woh qareeb-ul-nisbat (rishtedar) hi kyun na ho. In sahifon mein yeh bhi tha ke insan ke liye sirf wahi hai jo usne hasil kiya, yaani jis tarah is par dusre ka bojh nahi lada jayega, dusron ki bad-aamaliyon mein yeh nahi pakda jayega, aur isi tarah dusre ki neki bhi ise kuch faida na degi. 

Hazrat Imam Shafi'i aur unke mutabe'in ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke Quran khwani ka sawab murdon ko pahunchaya jaye to nahi pahunchta, isliye ke na to yeh unka amal hai aur na kasab. 2. Ya woh sadqa jo uske inteqal ke baad bhi jari rahe.
3. Ya woh ilm jis se nafa uthaya jata rahe.

Arab "akda" us waqt kehte hain maslan kuch log kuan khod rahe hon, darmiyan mein koi sakht chattan ajaye aur woh dastbardar ho jayein. Tum jo kuch kharch karoge, Allah Ta'ala tumhe us ka badla dega aur wahi behtareen raaziq hai.

Wa fi ke ma'ani ek to yeh kiye gaye hain ke unhein hukum kiya gaya tha woh sab unhein ne pohncha diya, dusre ma'ani yeh kiye gaye hain ke jo hukum mila use baja laye. Theek yeh hai ke yeh dono hi ma'ani durust hain jaisa ke aur ayat mein hai: Wa iz ibtala Ibrahima rabbuhu bi kalimatin fa atmahun (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 124). Ibrahim ko jab kabhi jis kisi azmayish ke sath us ke رب ne azmaya, aap ne kamyabi ke sath is mein number mila liye yani har hukum ko baja laye, har mana se ruke rahe, Rabb ki risalat poori tarah pohncha di, pas Allah ne unhein imam bana kar dusron ka un ka tab-e-dar bana diya jaisa ke irshad hua hai: Summa awhaina ilaika an اتباع millata Ibrahima hanifan wa ma kana minal mushrikin. Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke millat-e-Ibrahim Haneef ki pairwi kar jo mushrik na tha.

Tirmizi mein ek hadith-e-qudsi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Hazrat Ibrahim ke liye lafz "wafi" is liye farmaya ke woh har subh-o-sham in kalmaat ko parha karte the: Fa subhanAllahi hina tumsoona wa hina tusbihoon (Surah (Ar-Rum: 17) yahan tak ke Huzoor ﷺ ne ayat khatam ki.

Phir sagheera ya kabeera kiya to us ka wabaal khud us par hai, us ka yeh bojh koi aur na uthayega. Jaisa ke Quran-e-Kareem mein hai: Wa in tad'u musqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shai'un wa lau kana dha qurba, innama tunzirullazeena yakhshauna rabbahum bil-ghaibi wa aqamus-salata, wa man tazakka fa innama yatazakka linafsih, wa ilallahil-maseer (Surah (Fatir: 18).

(Fatir: 18), Agar koi bojh-ladd apna bojh uthane ke liye kisi ko pukarega, to usmein se kuch bhi na uthaya jayega, khwah woh qareeb-ul-nisbat (rishtedar) hi kyun na ho. In sahifon mein yeh bhi tha ke insan ke liye sirf wahi hai jo usne hasil kiya, yaani jis tarah is par dusre ka bojh nahi lada jayega, dusron ki bad-aamaliyon mein yeh nahi pakda jayega, aur isi tarah dusre ki neki bhi ise kuch faida na degi. 

Hazrat Imam Shafi'i aur unke mutabe'in ne is aayat se istidlal kiya hai ke Quran khwani ka sawab murdon ko pahunchaya jaye to nahi pahunchta, isliye ke na to yeh unka amal hai aur na kasab. Yehi wajah hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne na iska jawaz bayan kiya, na apni ummat ko is par raghib kiya, na unhe is par aamada kiya; na to kisi sareeh farman ke zariye se aur na kisi isharat-o-kinaye se. 

Theek isi tarah Sahaba-e-Kiram Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'in mein se kisi ek se yeh sabit nahi ke unne Quran padh kar uske sawab ka hadiya mayyat ke liye bheja ho. Agar yeh neki hoti aur mutabiq-e-shara' amal hota, to humse bahut zyada sabqat nekiyon ki taraf karne wale Sahaba-e-Kiram R.H Ajma'in the. 

Saath hi yeh baat bhi yaad rakhni chahiye ke nekiyon ke kaam Quran-o-Hadith ke saaf aur sahih farmanon se sabit hote hain, kisi qism ki raye aur qiyas ka inmein koi dakhal nahi. Haan, dua aur sadqa ka sawab mayyat ko pahunchta hai, is par ijma' hai aur Shari' A.S ke alfaz se sabit hai jo Hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ki riwayat se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Insan ke marne par uske aamal munqata' ho jate hain, lekin teen cheezein: 
1. Nek aulaad jo uske liye dua karti rahe.
2. Ya woh sadqa jo uske inteqal ke baad bhi jari rahe.
3. Ya woh ilm jis se nafa uthaya jata rahe.

Iska yeh matlab hai ke dar-haqeeqat yeh teenon cheezein bhi khud mayyat ki sa'yi, uski koshish aur uska amal hain. Yaani kisi aur ke amal ka ajr ise nahi pahunch raha.

Hazrat Mu'az ne qabila Bani Aud mein khutba padhte hue farmaya: "Aey Bani Aud! Main Allah ka, paighambar ka qasid ban kar tumhari taraf aya hoon. Tum yaqeen karo ke tumhara sab ka lautna Allah ki taraf hai, phir ya to jannat mein pohanchaye jao ya jahannam mein dhakele jao." 

Baghwi mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne is ayat ki tafseer mein farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ki zaat mein fikr karna jaiz nahi." Jaise aur hadees mein hai: "Maklooq par ghor bhari nazrein dalo lekin zaat-e-Khaliq mein gehre na utro." Isay aql-o-adraak, fikr-o-zehn nahi pa sakta. Go in lafzon se yeh hadees mehfooz nahi magar sahih hadees mein yeh bhi mazmoon mojood hai. Is mein hai ke shaitan kisi ke pas ata hai aur kehta hai: "Isay kis ne paida kiya? Phir isay kis ne paida kiya?" Yahan tak ke kehta hai: "Allah Ta'ala ko kis ne paida kiya?" Jab tum mein se kisi ke dil mein yeh waswasa paida ho to A'uzu padh le aur is khayal ko dil se door kar de. 

Sunan ki ek hadees mein hai: "Maklooqaat-e-Allah mein ghor-o-fikr karo lekin zaat-e-Allah mein ghor-o-fikr na karo. Suno! Allah Ta'ala ne ek farishta paida kiya hai jis ke kaan ki lo se lekar moondhe tak teen sau saal ka rasta hai, au kama qal." 

Phir farmata hai ke bandon mein hansne rone ka mada aur un ke asbab bhi usi ne paida kiye hain jo bilkul mukhtalif hain. Wohi maut-o-hayat ka khaliq hai, jaise farmaya ayat: (Allazi khalaqal mawta wal hayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amala, wa huwal-azizul-ghafoor) (Al-Mulk: 2). Us ne maut-o-hayat ko paida kiya. Usi ne nutfa se har jandar ko joda joda banaya, jaise aur jagah farman hai ayat: (Ayahsabul insanu an yutraka suda) (Al-Qiyamah: 36), "Kya insan samajhta hai ke woh bekar chhor diya jayega? Kya woh mani ka qatra na tha jo (rahm mein) tapkaya jata hai? Phir kya woh basta khoon na tha? Phir Allah ne usay paida kiya aur durust kiya aur is se jode yani nar-o-mada banaye. Kya (aisi qudrato wala) Allah is baat par qadir nahi? Ke murdon ko zinda kar de." 

Phir farmata hai isi par dobara zinda karna yani jaise us ne ibtida paida kiya usi tarah maar dalne ke baad dobara ki paidayish bhi usi ke zimme hai. Usi ne apne bandon ko ghani bana diya aur maal un ke qabze mein de diya hai jo un ke pas hi ba-taur ponji ke rehta hai. Aksar mufassireen ke kalam ka khulasa is maqam par yahi hai, go baaz se marwi hai ke us ne maal diya aur ghulam diye, us ne diya aur khush hua, isay ghani bana kar aur maklooq ko is ka dast-nigar bana diya, jise chaha ghani kiya jise chaha faqeer, lekin yeh pichle dono qool lafz se kuch zyada mutabqat nahi rakhte.

Shi'ra is us roshan sitare ka naam hai jise Mirzam-ul-Jauza bhi kehte hain. Ba'az arab iski parastish karte thay. Aad-e-Ula yaani Qaum-e-Hud ko jise Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nuh bhi kaha jata hai, usi ne unki na-farmani ki bina par tabaah kar diya, jaise farmaya aayat (Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi-'aad) [Al-Fajr: 6-8], yaani kya tu ne nahi dekha ke tere Rabb ne Aad ke saath kya kiya? Yaani Iram ke saath jo bade qad-awar thay, jinka misl shahron mein paida nahi kiya gaya tha. Yeh qaum badi qawi aur zor-awar thi, saath hi Allah ki badi na-farman aur Rasool se badi sar-kash thi. Un par hawa ka azaab aaya jo saat raatein aur aath din barabar raha. Isi tarah Samudiyon ko bhi usne halak kar diya jisme se ek bhi baqi na bacha, aur unse pehle Qaum-e-Nuh tabaah ho chuki hai jo bade na-insaaf aur shareer thay, aur Lut ki bastiyan jinhe Rahman-o-Qahhar ne zer-o-zabar kar diya aur asmani patharon se sab bad-karon ko halak kar diya. Phir farmaya, phir tu, ae insan! Apne Rabb ki kis kis na'mat par jhagdega? Go in lafzon se yeh hadees mehfooz nahi magar sahih hadees mein yeh bhi mazmoon mojood hai. Is mein hai ke shaitan kisi ke pas ata hai aur kehta hai: "Isay kis ne paida kiya? Phir isay kis ne paida kiya?" Yahan tak ke kehta hai: "Allah Ta'ala ko kis ne paida kiya?" Jab tum mein se kisi ke dil mein yeh waswasa paida ho to A'uzu padh le aur is khayal ko dil se door kar de. 

Sunan ki ek hadees mein hai: "Maklooqaat-e-Allah mein ghor-o-fikr karo lekin zaat-e-Allah mein ghor-o-fikr na karo. Suno! Allah Ta'ala ne ek farishta paida kiya hai jis ke kaan ki lo se lekar moondhe tak teen sau saal ka rasta hai, au kama qal." 

Phir farmata hai ke bandon mein hansne rone ka mada aur un ke asbab bhi usi ne paida kiye hain jo bilkul mukhtalif hain. Wohi maut-o-hayat ka khaliq hai, jaise farmaya ayat: (Allazi khalaqal mawta wal hayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amala, wa huwal-azizul-ghafoor) (Al-Mulk: 2). Us ne maut-o-hayat ko paida kiya. Usi ne nutfa se har jandar ko joda joda banaya, jaise aur jagah farman hai ayat: (Ayahsabul insanu an yutraka suda) (Al-Qiyamah: 36), "Kya insan samajhta hai ke woh bekar chhor diya jayega? Kya woh mani ka qatra na tha jo (rahm mein) tapkaya jata hai? Phir kya woh basta khoon na tha? Phir Allah ne usay paida kiya aur durust kiya aur is se jode yani nar-o-mada banaye. Kya (aisi qudrato wala) Allah is baat par qadir nahi? Ke murdon ko zinda kar de." 

Phir farmata hai isi par dobara zinda karna yani jaise us ne ibtida paida kiya usi tarah maar dalne ke baad dobara ki paidayish bhi usi ke zimme hai. Usi ne apne bandon ko ghani bana diya aur maal un ke qabze mein de diya hai jo un ke pas hi ba-taur ponji ke rehta hai. Aksar mufassireen ke kalam ka khulasa is maqam par yahi hai, go baaz se marwi hai ke us ne maal diya aur ghulam diye, us ne diya aur khush hua, isay ghani bana kar aur maklooq ko is ka dast-nigar bana diya, jise chaha ghani kiya jise chaha faqeer, lekin yeh pichle dono qool lafz se kuch zyada mutabqat nahi rakhte.

Shi'ra is us roshan sitare ka naam hai jise Mirzam-ul-Jauza bhi kehte hain. Ba'az arab iski parastish karte thay. Aad-e-Ula yaani Qaum-e-Hud ko jise Aad bin Iram bin Sam bin Nuh bhi kaha jata hai, usi ne unki na-farmani ki bina par tabaah kar diya, jaise farmaya aayat (Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi-'aad) [Al-Fajr: 6-8], yaani kya tu ne nahi dekha ke tere Rabb ne Aad ke saath kya kiya? Yaani Iram ke saath jo bade qad-awar thay, jinka misl shahron mein paida nahi kiya gaya tha. Yeh qaum badi qawi aur zor-awar thi, saath hi Allah ki badi na-farman aur Rasool se badi sar-kash thi. Un par hawa ka azaab aaya jo saat raatein aur aath din barabar raha. Isi tarah Samudiyon ko bhi usne halak kar diya jisme se ek bhi baqi na bacha, aur unse pehle Qaum-e-Nuh tabaah ho chuki hai jo bade na-insaaf aur shareer thay, aur Lut ki bastiyan jinhe Rahman-o-Qahhar ne zer-o-zabar kar diya aur asmani patharon se sab bad-karon ko halak kar diya. Unhe ek cheez ne dhanp liya yaani (patharon ne) jinka meena un par barsa aur bure halon tabaah hue. In bastiyon mein chaar lakh aadmi aabad thay. Abadi ki kul zameen ki aag aur gandhak aur tel ban kar un par bhadak uthi. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ka yahi qaul hai jo bahut ghareeb sanad se Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Phir farmaya, phir tu, ae insan! Apne Rabb ki kis kis na'mat par jhagdega? Ba'az kehte hain khitab Nabi ﷺ se hai lekin khitab ko aam rakhna bahut awla hai, Ibn Jarir bhi aam rakhne ko hi pasand farmate hain.

"Nazir" ka mafhoom Nazir kehte kise hain? Yeh khauf aur dar se aagah karne wale hain, yani An-Hazrat ﷺ aap ki risalat bhi aisi hi thi jaise aap se pehle rasoolon ki risalat thi. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: Ayat (Qul ma kuntu bid'an minar-rusuli wa ma adri ma yuf'alu bi wa la bikum in attabi'u illa ma yuha ilayya wa ma ana illa nazirun mubin) (Al-Ahqaf: 9), yani main koi naya rasool to hoon nahi, risalat mujh se shuru nahi hui, balki duniya mein mujh se pehle bhi bohat se rasool aa chuke hain. Qareeb aane wali ka waqt aayega, yani Qiyamat qareeb aa gayi. Na to ise koi dafa kar sake na is ke aane ke sahi waqt-e-muayyan ka kisi ko ilm hai. Nazir arabi mein use kehte hain, misal ke taur par ek jamalat hai jis mein se ek shakhs ne koi darauni cheez dekhi aur apni kaum ko is se aagah karta hai, yani dar aur khauf sunane wala. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: Ayat (In huwa illa nazirun lakum baina yadai 'azabin shadid) (Saba: 46), main tumhe sakht azab se muttala karne wala hoon. Hadith mein hai: Tumhe khul-am-khula darane wala hoon. Yani jis tarah koi shakhs kisi burai ko dekh le ke woh kaum ke qareeb pahunch chuki hai aur phir jis halat mein ho usi mein dauda bhaaga aa jaye aur kaum ko daf'atan mutanabbih kar de ke dekho woh bala aa rahi hai, foran tadaruk kar lo. Isi tarah Qiyamat ke holnak azab bhi logon ki ghaflat ki halat mein un se bilkul qareeb ho gaye hain aur An-Hazrat ﷺ un azabon se hoshiyar kar rahe hain. Jaise is ke baad ki soorat mein hai: Ayat (Iqtarabatis-sa'atu wan-shaqqal-qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1), Qiyamat qareeb aa chuki hai. Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Logo gunahon ko chhota aur haqeer janne se bacho, suno chhote chhote gunahon ki misal aisi hai jaise ek qafila kisi jagah utra, sab idhar udhar chale gaye aur lakdiyan samet kar thodi thodi le aaye, to chahe har ek ke paas lakdiyan kam kam hain lekin jab woh sab jama kar li jayen to ek anbaar lag jata hai jis se degen pak jayen. Isi tarah chhote chhote gunah jama ho kar dher lag jata hai aur achanak us gunahgaar ko pakad leta hai aur halak ho jata hai. Aur hadith mein hai: Meri aur Qiyamat ki misal aisi hai, phir aap ne apni shahadat ki aur darmiyan ki ungli utha kar un ka fasla dikhaya, meri aur Qiyamat ki misal do sa'aton ki si hai. Meri aur aakhirat ke din ki misal theek usi tarah hai jis tarah ek kaum ne kisi shakhs ko itlaa lane ke liye bheja, us ne dushman ke lashkar ko bilkul nazeeq ki kameen-gah mein chhaapa marne ke liye tayyar dekha yahan tak ke use dar laga ke mere pahunchne se pehle hi kahin yeh na pahunch jayen, to woh ek teele par chadh gaya aur wahin kapda hila hila kar unhe isharay se bata diya ke khabardar ho jao dushman sar par maujood hai, pas main aisa hi darane wala hoon. Is hadith ki shahadat mein aur bhi bohat si hasan aur sahih hadeethein maujood hain.

Phir mushrikeen ke is fel par inkar farmaya ke woh Quran sunte hain magar earaz karte hain aur be-parwahi barte hain balkay is ki rahmat ke sath taajjub ke sath inkar kar baithte hain aur is se mazaq sunte hain magar earaz karte hain aur be-parwahi barte hain balkay is ki rahmat ke sath taajjub ke sath inkar kar baithte hain aur is se mazaq aur hansi karne lagte hain chahiye yeh tha ke misl iman daron ke ise sun kar rote ibrat hasil karte jaise momino ki halat bayan farmayi ke woh is Kalamullah Shareef ko sun kar rote dhote sajde mein gir parte hain aur khushoo-o-khuzoo mein barh jate hain. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain (Samad) gane ko kehte hain yeh yamni lughat hai. Aap se (Samadoon) ke maani earaz karne wale aur takabbur karne wale bhi marwi hain. Hazrat Ali aur Hasan farmate hain ghaflat karne wale. 

Phir apne bandon ka hukum deta hai ke tauheed-o-ikhlas ke paband raho khushoo, khuloos aur tauheed ke manne wale ban jao. 

Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne, musalmanon ne, mushrikon ne aur jinn-o-ins ne Surah An-Najm ke sajde ke moqe par sajda kiya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Makkah mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Surah An-Najm parhi pas Aap ne sajda kiya aur un logon ne bhi jo Aap ke paas the. Rawi-e-Hadees Muttalib bin Abi Wada'ah kehte hain main ne apna sar uthaya aur sajda na kiya, yeh us waqt tak musalman nahi huwe the, islam ke baad jis kisi ki zubani is Surah Mubarakah ki tilawat sunte sajda karte, yeh hadees Nasai Shareef mein bhi hai.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain (Samad) gane ko kehte hain yeh yamni lughat hai. Aap se (Samadoon) ke maani earaz karne wale aur takabbur karne wale bhi marwi hain. Hazrat Ali aur Hasan farmate hain ghaflat karne wale. 

Phir apne bandon ka hukum deta hai ke tauheed-o-ikhlas ke paband raho khushoo, khuloos aur tauheed ke manne wale ban jao. 

Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne, musalmanon ne, mushrikon ne aur jinn-o-ins ne Surah An-Najm ke sajde ke moqe par sajda kiya. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Makkah mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Surah An-Najm parhi pas Aap ne sajda kiya aur un logon ne bhi jo Aap ke paas the. Rawi-e-Hadees Muttalib bin Abi Wada'ah kehte hain main ne apna sar uthaya aur sajda na kiya, yeh us waqt tak musalman nahi huwe the, islam ke baad jis kisi ki zubani is Surah Mubarakah ki tilawat sunte sajda karte, yeh hadees Nasai Shareef mein bhi hai.

"Nazir" ka mafhoom Nazir kehte kise hain? Yeh khauf aur dar se aagah karne wale hain, yani An-Hazrat ﷺ aap ki risalat bhi aisi hi thi jaise aap se pehle rasoolon ki risalat thi. Nazir arabi mein use kehte hain, misal ke taur par ek jamalat hai jis mein se ek shakhs ne koi darauni cheez dekhi aur apni kaum ko is se aagah karta hai, yani dar aur khauf sunane wala. Hadith mein hai: Tumhe khul-am-khula darane wala hoon. Yani jis tarah koi shakhs kisi burai ko dekh le ke woh kaum ke qareeb pahunch chuki hai aur phir jis halat mein ho usi mein dauda bhaaga aa jaye aur kaum ko daf'atan mutanabbih kar de ke dekho woh bala aa rahi hai, foran tadaruk kar lo. Isi tarah Qiyamat ke holnak azab bhi logon ki ghaflat ki halat mein un se bilkul qareeb ho gaye hain aur An-Hazrat ﷺ un azabon se hoshiyar kar rahe hain. Jaise is ke baad ki soorat mein hai: Ayat (Iqtarabatis-sa'atu wan-shaqqal-qamar) (Al-Qamar: 1), Qiyamat qareeb aa chuki hai. Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Logo gunahon ko chhota aur haqeer janne se bacho, suno chhote chhote gunahon ki misal aisi hai jaise ek qafila kisi jagah utra, sab idhar udhar chale gaye aur lakdiyan samet kar thodi thodi le aaye, to chahe har ek ke paas lakdiyan kam kam hain lekin jab woh sab jama kar li jayen to ek anbaar lag jata hai jis se degen pak jayen. Isi tarah chhote chhote gunah jama ho kar dher lag jata hai aur achanak us gunahgaar ko pakad leta hai aur halak ho jata hai. Aur hadith mein hai: Meri aur Qiyamat ki misal aisi hai, phir aap ne apni shahadat ki aur darmiyan ki ungli utha kar un ka fasla dikhaya, meri aur Qiyamat ki misal do sa'aton ki si hai. Meri aur aakhirat ke din ki misal theek usi tarah hai jis tarah ek kaum ne kisi shakhs ko itlaa lane ke liye bheja, us ne dushman ke lashkar ko bilkul nazeeq ki kameen-gah mein chhaapa marne ke liye tayyar dekha yahan tak ke use dar laga ke mere pahunchne se pehle hi kahin yeh na pahunch jayen, to woh ek teele par chadh gaya aur wahin kapda hila hila kar unhe isharay se bata diya ke khabardar ho jao dushman sar par maujood hai, pas main aisa hi darane wala hoon.
